name: Ruben Gallego
subject: My family, my community, my Marines, and you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
When I think back to the most difficult experiences in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a strong support system to get me to the other side.
#
_* Sent in support of Ruben Gallego for Arizona and Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate *_
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59459?refcode=em20240720-7003&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7003%2E614464%2EoGBr_a)
_Me and my sisters when we were (much) younger_
Peter —
When I think back to the most difficult experiences in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a strong support system to get me to the other side.
Sleeping on the floor in our apartment growing up because we couldn’t afford a bed wasn’t easy.
Working to make ends meet while I was trying to get into a good school wasn’t easy.
Serving in Iraq in one of the hardest hit units of the entire war definitely wasn’t easy.
And running for the U.S. Senate — having Kari Lake attack me day in, day out, while Trump helps her raise millions to smear my name... that hasn’t been easy either.
But as a kid, I had my family.
Getting into school and building a better life, I had a strong community supporting me.
Getting through Iraq, I had my brothers watching my back.
And in this campaign, I have you.
Simply put... I couldn’t do this without your support, Peter When you woke up this morning you probably didn’t think it’d be the day you made a donation to my campaign, but I really need you if we’re going to defeat Kari Lake and defend Arizona and control of the U.S. Senate.
**[Peter, can you split an online donation to my campaign and Lucas Kunce before our next major fundraising deadline? Polls are showing this race getting closer and closer. | | Dear Friend, Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we’ve seen a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and against capitalism.
---
| [](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkb-O3CAQh58Gd7b4Z7ALipMcV7kUaVIiDGMbCYwF7EX79pF3V9GW187MNzOffn8-9afxwR_bLxNBrSHrXLQBvaf0Bbm15vTVBF-ippjyFsuWEs0apzAZHecNKCIp6XsqGW52tQBYQ8gizCL7RQI4KbjEFDg1wzpC49W1B0tKsOSCkG4d7CoxG0eGe4KNRRybALl2awZwKZrDBb9ArvcMZ8q1syk2Qe21ngWxD0RnROcMJd2yhdI9_-5S3hCdd19qyvc2rW1J1j88WnO4N62LZ_OtRm1NPI3fDsSmF6f_Q_odENf08x5i05lTOcFWf2yvVgTnbxGxCaLx4VW06ahwVMSmjx_t_PN3TwbBEBUpWMQmNgg5NFm5868PwRchEcfbhT906_eD-VL0XwAAAP__nZCb_w)

| | **But do they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and capitalism?** This is _precisely_ why we put together this brand new eBook, **[_The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkb-O3CAQh58Gd7b4Z7ALipMcV7kUaVIiDGMbCYwF7EX79pF3V9GW187MNzOffn8-9afxwR_bLxNBrSHrXLQBvaf0Bbm15vTVBF-ippjyFsuWEs0apzAZHecNKCIp6XsqGW52tQBYQ8gizCL7RQI4KbjEFDg1wzpC49W1B0tKsOSCkG4d7CoxG0eGe4KNRRybALl2awZwKZrDBb9ArvcMZ8q1syk2Qe21ngWxD0RnROcMJd2yhdI9_-5S3hCdd19qyvc2rW1J1j88WnO4N62LZ_OtRm1NPI3fDsSmF6f_Q_odENf08x5i05lTOcFWf2yvVgTnbxGxCaLx4VW06ahwVMSmjx_t_PN3TwbBEBUpWMQmNgg5NFm5868PwRchEcfbhT906_eD-VL0XwAAAP__nZCb_w)**[](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkb-O3CAQh58Gd7b4Z7ALipMcV7kUaVIiDGMbCYwF7EX79pF3V9GW187MNzOffn8-9afxwR_bLxNBrSHrXLQBvaf0Bbm15vTVBF-ippjyFsuWEs0apzAZHecNKCIp6XsqGW52tQBYQ8gizCL7RQI4KbjEFDg1wzpC49W1B0tKsOSCkG4d7CoxG0eGe4KNRRybALl2awZwKZrDBb9ArvcMZ8q1syk2Qe21ngWxD0RnROcMJd2yhdI9_-5S3hCdd19qyvc2rW1J1j88WnO4N62LZ_OtRm1NPI3fDsSmF6f_Q_odENf08x5i05lTOcFWf2yvVgTnbxGxCaLx4VW06ahwVMSmjx_t_PN3TwbBEBUpWMQmNgg5NFm5868PwRchEcfbhT906_eD-VL0XwAAAP__nZCb_w), from Hoover Institution senior fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson. name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Broadcast
subject: Defending liberty is even more urgent
body:
That’s why Hillsdale College launched Imprimis over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense.

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/9utN4Pq-kUFy5M3-WZV7VQ~~/AARclAA~~~)
---
| | Fellow American,

Every day, we seem to learn more about the agenda of the anti-American Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, to suppress conservative speech and political activity, and push their false and dishonest narratives about American history and current events.

That's why Hillsdale College launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

You'll be pleased to know that America's leading digest of liberty, _Imprimis_ , has grown to more than 6.6 million.

Today, with the radical Left increasing its efforts to undermine traditional patriotism and transform American government and society, _Imprimis_ is more important than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, the destruction of historical monuments, and the politicizing of sports by forces who believe America is fundamentally unjust.

**In response, Hillsdale College is determined to expand its national outreach efforts that reach and teach millions on behalf of liberty --including _Imprimis_. **

**Hillsdale sends _Imprimis_ ten times a year--and it does so free of charge.**

Since _Imprimis_ began in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **we have never charged for a subscription.**

And as I think you know, Hillsdale is one of only a very few American colleges that refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government support--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

This principled independence frees Hillsdale from many burdensome and corrupting federal regulations--but it also means that Hillsdale is entirely dependent on the generosity of private citizens like you who understand the importance of education to liberty.

**The only way Hillsdale can continue its work on behalf of liberty --including sending _Imprimis_ to millions of households and businesses each month--is if citizens like you continue to give us your support.**

While a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses. **

To do so, we need to address the significant printing and mailing costs of _Imprimis_. That is why I am asking you to consider helping us reach our 2024 _Imprimis_ funding goal.

[**Can I count on you to send a tax-deductible gift today to help reach this goal and to help Hillsdale expand its educational outreach efforts --including _Imprimis_?**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/9utN4Pq-kUFy5M3-WZV7VQ~~/AARclAA~~~)

Any amount you can give will help, and we will be honored by your partnership in the cause of liberty.

Please use the secure link below to send a tax-deductible gift to help Hillsdale reach its _Imprimis_ funding goal and support other efforts on behalf of liberty.

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/9utN4Pq-kUFy5M3-WZV7VQ~~/AARclAA~~~)

All of us at Hillsdale are deeply grateful for your support.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| |
---

Conservative Broadcast

body:
That’s why Hillsdale College launched Imprimis over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/b3VWq7nMhrIRU7Hjq8L3Ng~~/AARclAA~/RgRof3MOP0StaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2RlZmVuZC1saWJlcnR5P3NjPTAxNDAyTjAyNDJMQ1pET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1pbXByaW1pcyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1TSE9SVF9QQS1ST04tMjAyNDA3MjFXA3NwY0IKZpVo2pxm7qga-VIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
---
| | Fellow American,

Every day, we seem to learn more about the agenda of the anti-American Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, to suppress conservative speech and political activity, and push their false and dishonest narratives about American history and current events.

That's why Hillsdale College launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

You'll be pleased to know that America's leading digest of liberty, _Imprimis_ , has grown to more than 6.6 million.

Today, with the radical Left increasing its efforts to undermine traditional patriotism and transform American government and society, _Imprimis_ is more important than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, the destruction of historical monuments, and the politicizing of sports by forces who believe America is fundamentally unjust.

**In response, Hillsdale College is determined to expand its national outreach efforts that reach and teach millions on behalf of liberty --including _Imprimis_. **

**Hillsdale sends _Imprimis_ ten times a year--and it does so free of charge.**

Since _Imprimis_ began in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **we have never charged for a subscription.**

And as I think you know, Hillsdale is one of only a very few American colleges that refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government support--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

This principled independence frees Hillsdale from many burdensome and corrupting federal regulations--but it also means that Hillsdale is entirely dependent on the generosity of private citizens like you who understand the importance of education to liberty.

**The only way Hillsdale can continue its work on behalf of liberty --including sending _Imprimis_ to millions of households and businesses each month--is if citizens like you continue to give us your support.**

While a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses. **

To do so, we need to address the significant printing and mailing costs of _Imprimis_. That is why I am asking you to consider helping us reach our 2024 _Imprimis_ funding goal.

[**Can I count on you to send a tax-deductible gift today to help reach this goal and to help Hillsdale expand its educational outreach efforts --including _Imprimis_?**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/b3VWq7nMhrIRU7Hjq8L3Ng~~/AARclAA~/RgRof3MOP0StaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2RlZmVuZC1saWJlcnR5P3NjPTAxNDAyTjAyNDJMQ1pET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1pbXByaW1pcyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1TSE9SVF9QQS1ST04tMjAyNDA3MjFXA3NwY0IKZpVo2pxm7qga-VIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)

Any amount you can give will help, and we will be honored by your partnership in the cause of liberty.

Please use the secure link below to send a tax-deductible gift to help Hillsdale reach its _Imprimis_ funding goal and support other efforts on behalf of liberty.

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/b3VWq7nMhrIRU7Hjq8L3Ng~~/AARclAA~/RgRof3MOP0StaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2RlZmVuZC1saWJlcnR5P3NjPTAxNDAyTjAyNDJMQ1pET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1pbXByaW1pcyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1TSE9SVF9QQS1ST04tMjAyNDA3MjFXA3NwY0IKZpVo2pxm7qga-VIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)

All of us at Hillsdale are deeply grateful for your support.

subject: If you're over age 40 and eat ALMONDS or PISTACHIOS - read this
body:
We've been told our whole lives to eat certain fruits, vegetables, and whole grains to stay in good health.

We've been told our whole lives to eat certain fruits, vegetables, and whole grains to stay in good health.
However, according to Dr. Steven Gundry -- a world-renowned heart surgeon -- many so called **" health foods" in the American diet contain a dangerous toxin, that could be expanding your waistline.**
**" This toxin causes micro-tears to form in your fragile intestinal-wall -- allowing bacteria and waste products to seep into your body."** Says Dr. Gundry.
This harmful condition is best known as "leaky gut," and it's affecting millions of people nationwide. **Warning signs include weight gain, fatigue, digestive discomfort, stiff, achy joints, and even skin problems.**
Dr. Gundry explains, "**These side effects are often mistaken for normal signs of aging, because leaky gut usually develops over a matter of years, and sometimes even decades. But I can assure you, the damage caused by these so called "health foods" is far from normal."**
The good news is, this problem can be **easily fixed from your own home.**
"It's very simple, you just have to know which foods are actually healthy, and which contain this hidden toxin," he goes on to explain.
By simply eliminating this harmful toxin, Dr. Gundry has seen thousands of his own patients make swift recoveries. (In fact, he even lost 70lbs himself!)
Now, after years of research, Dr. Gundry has decided to release an informative video to the public -- free and uninterrupted -- showcasing exactly which foods you need to avoid.
"Good health is one of life's toughest obstacles," he explains. "So, if this video can help people achieve that, I'll be thrilled to hear I was of help."
The video has since gone viral, first being shared by users on Facebook, then being featured on news sites like ABC and CBS.
So far, the comments and feedback have been outstanding, with thousands of Americans feeling better than they have in decades.

clean_body: In the past few years, we've seen a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and against capitalism. | | | | | Dear Friend, Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we've seen a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and against capitalism. | | | But do they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and capitalism? This is precisely why we put together this brand new eBook, , from Hoover Institution senior fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson. This eBook consists of two papers--one from each scholar--written in conjunction with The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and Free-Market Capitalism. This project provides objective and scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and well-being. I think you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely, given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political leaders. ## Trump Holds First Rally Since Assassination Attempt
The Trump campaign [held a rally Saturday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2urCAUxfGngU4DW4RYUNyGbm57SsPARvcEP4Kombc_malPuZKV_JL_z2N8eMq0Tv_9grambfSh0oWjaUA2oEbFo02IgB1HKw3IXg_9IPlsYzIiYAqgRa-DkVorpQ0Oset1EPrJyYIAJQxIKYRUstVDHJR4AqbYp4iRKYGR6lba10ZrnTHl93ZhacO28GznWveDdf8YOAbuvu-2zjidvkTy6-fDwJ1Hs-J9MHC-VAoZGbiPysC9zvwdDFwt57I3C4WZJr82xef85sXG_aac6dCGKTEtnvJXrn93uCz8BgAA__9DO19u) in Grand Rapids, Michigan--the first since the July 13 attempted assassination in Butler, Pennsylvania, and since Trump named J.D. Vance as his running mate. Vance took the stage in the battleground state as [12,000 piled into the indoor event](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO4yAQgOGnsTsswDg2BcU16XLtlRaBIcwJg-WZxJu3X2Xrrb_m1__vtt48FqyPv34Dx6mtPjC-YJ2FVkKb1fTRJQANYw9OzVpNFztZ1WcXIcllCulu7GjlqMAu-j5Gvchltmkce3RaaiNnrZSUyqjhYqM18q4hxSlFiJ2REJHbMfxvWDlDKu_2gmMIbeuLy8w7deOfTl87fT3Pc0jtq8JJH-_0dW8FGQN90HPIgnN7kq-RRAQKUKPYMGR8-Cq4nVUkPIgFH89tF4cv5S0IawCRkUTyWCAKT-SJsHrGVoVnhm3n_nBxP7EUpMvcGfnYPJafSP592cvp7wAAAP__tFJzPQ), and he responded to Vice President Kamala Harris' remarks about Vance's RNC speech. For his part, Trump countered the idea that he is a threat to democracy by saying, "I took a bullet for democracy," and jabbed at the chaos in the Democratic party surrounding whether Biden will go through with a re-election bid. As expected, the huge crowds in Grand Rapids dealt with [increased security](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGvozAQhH8NdIvwxkAoXFyTLtdeiRx7SfZkWGTvg5d__0TqV41mNMXM9-8-3T0nXp9__UJOZ5l8UN5pGgANoJ1sHd1MhHSpyZkBTdeP3Wjql_M9Xh7XDqMJfdcHiiEGQuODvdIVH6Fmhy3adkBj2tZY0_RjHG37QJpjN0eKlW0pskpu_guv-qI5vWWn3ARZ6uReqlupLn8qvFV4O46jmeXbDLImXunsVHhb6SineGVZfYJNEiuHM_MLZQ4edlE6_SIqOfhIsGXaIJNypghL2SCS0uc2FAqZFArlnQNBYs9FVkj-XYAVfEogX1pnF7eDU-LSD5Vtn4vn9FmtvzPcHf4EAAD__ykMeWE) as the Secret Service continues to face scrutiny over last Saturday's shooting.
## Israel Strikes Yemen
Israel has confirmed [it struck Hodeidah](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzGPozAQRn-N3RnZY4OhcHENXa69EjnMOMzJ4Ai8sPn3q6Te7pM-6T29f7fpFjnz9vgbVwo1lSnOlU-avAKjwE1OYkhEQFZSMB5M2w3tYOQSrL1rbzvdO9O6XlM_d9agTXPCiK3tJQfQ4LQHY7Q2zjTdgIPTd6CEbUJC4TQh17I3_wtvdaGUX-WkvZnLKnNYan0ewv4RMAoYr-tq4jeX4_0KGN9sAaP2ny1g5GOPlNWLVtrUUr7qwoeqlFU8-VS4l43kHvB5cc58dF44_Vgj54-t_t5-BvgJAAD__zHSWpU), a port city in Yemen, one day after a Houthi drone attack in Tel Aviv. The Yemen-based group had claimed responsibility for the Tel Aviv attack that killed one person and injured 10 others. Israeli ministers highlighted the [potential ramifications of the strike](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7tuxCAQAL8GurPYNfhRUKRxd2lTWsAuNhE2JxvZyt9HlzrdSCONNF_P-elSTvvy6Ta2NZbZhZounvsHwgP1rCXZyIzcSrbQI5huNCPI1YKPEKiFGFXvfKBBKwyGox-ITUskk0WFWvUIoBRoaLqRRq08ciQTiUloxZRqOZrvkva6csw_5eKjCWWT2a61vk7RfgicBE73fTfeh7cTOO18nwInd9QUMr8xtEs3LABamyIPS6875ZzOrhdaLZtL-a9a_3-8LP4GAAD__0I3U58), recognizing that "an active front is being opened against the Houthis that will lead to a chain of responses," but also said they were advised against restraint in response to the Tel Aviv attack. This is the first time Israel has ever directly attacked Yemen.

A new J.D. Power [ranking of most reliable car brands](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1utDAQAJ_GdEbePfPjwsXX0N3XpkQLXo5NDJxsHyhvH-Xq1DPSSPNxH-8kUfbHf9rYl-UYaS5y8thpBI12tFXwCzPyrWIPHULTusZBtfre3YBD30NjOoPY9W0bmB1MrQPqF6zEo0FrOgQwBizUrQvOmgl5Cc0SOChrOEg5Uv15yF5WXuL3cXKq52Orol9LeWZ1-6dwUDhc11Wfkl8UZ3pKoSi5_IoKh0T7FwddVtbbkYtOHIWmyHqmpKdEe8ha9jd_6axwqJIPz0tilNx2yprHRhLf1fL3g9PjTwAAAP__FBFfhg) in the U.S. lists Toyota and its luxury arm, Lexus, as the best two brands, followed by Buick and Chevrolet. Dear Friend,

As followers of Jesus, we are all compelled to address a critical need that exists across the globe:**Billions of people wake up each day without the comfort and guidance of the Word of God in their native language.**

In some regions, entire communities have yet to receive a single verse of scripture, while others face a severe shortage of Bibles.

I'm reaching out to you because we believe that together, we can make a profound impact on the lives of those who are yearning for the transformative power of the gospel.

**Will you provide Bibles to people groups who have yet to hear God 's Word with a gift today?**

Our commitment to providing Bibles and Scripture portions to people and communities worldwide is unwavering. However, we recognize that we cannot do this alone. We need your help to ensure that the gospel reaches every corner of the world.

When you give today, you will:
* Not only pass a Bible along but potentially change lives eternally.
* Help support over 3,500 IMB missionaries on the ground, teaching the Bible and bringing hope to spiritually lost communities.
* Answer God's call to share His Word with those who have yet to hear it.

[ ](http://trk.secureandprosper._hcxhEj0ksEw)
You can click on the secure link below to make a donation of any amount and bring the transformative power of the gospel to those who need it the most.

[https://www.imb.org/generosity/gods-word-for-the-nations-confirmation/](http://trk.secureandprosper.-H5e7DRdw)

Your support is more than a financial contribution; it's a beacon of hope, a lifeline to those who have yet to experience the love and salvation found in Jesus Christ.

Thank you for considering this urgent call to action. Together, we can make a difference in the lives of countless individuals and communities worldwide.

In faith,

Angie Shepherd

Prayer and Missions Advocate

I'm reaching out to you because we believe that together, we can make a profound impact on the lives of those who are yearning for the transformative power of the gospel. Will you provide Bibles to people groups who have yet to hear God 's Word with a gift today? Our commitment to providing Bibles and Scripture portions to people and communities worldwide is unwavering. However, we recognize that we cannot do this alone. We need your help to ensure that the gospel reaches every corner of the world. When you give today, you will: Not only pass a Bible along but potentially change lives eternally. Help support over 3,500 IMB missionaries on the ground, teaching the Bible and bringing hope to spiritually lost communities. * Answer God's call to share His Word with those who have yet to hear it. You can click on the secure link below to make a donation of any amount and bring the transformative power of the gospel to those who need it the most. Your support is more than a financial contribution; it's a beacon of hope, a lifeline to those who have yet to experience the love and salvation found in Jesus Christ. Thank you for considering this urgent call to action. Together, we can make a difference in the lives of countless individuals and communities worldwide. In faith, Angie Shepherd Journeyman Alumni Prayer and Missions Advocate | | International Mission Board | 3806 Monument Ave. Richmond, VA 23230 | (804) 353-0515 Secure & Prosper PO Box 455 Leesburg, VA 20178 If you no longer wish to receive sponsored promotional emails from us to unsubscribe.

# [The world’s longest-burning lightbulb has been on since 1901.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgyzxa&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Science & Industry](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgyzxa&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgyzxa&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| T echnology such as LED lighting has made lightbulbs last longer than ever, but no modern bulb even comes close to the incandescent Centennial Light, which has been glowing inside a fire station in the San Francisco Bay Area since 1901. The light shines for 24 hours a day, though it has taken a few breaks here and there for power outages, renovations, and venue changes. It was first installed in a cart house — so named when fire hoses traveled on carts, not trucks — but moved to a large firehouse nearby soon after. In 1903, it moved again to a newly built station. It stayed there until 1976, when it moved to its present home in Livermore, California. At that point the bulb had been operational for 75 years, and had become a sensation; it even got a police and fire truck escort for the journey, which was slightly less than 2 miles.
---
Unsurprisingly, the bulb’s survival probably boils down to good craftsmanship. The thick glass was hand-blown, and the bulb has a thick, durable carbon filament, unlike the thin tungsten filaments that became standard later. That was all mounted by hand on a sturdy brass base. Additionally, it’s filled with nitrogen gas, which is gentler than the argon and krypton gas used in later incandescents. The second longest burning lightbulb, located in Fort Worth, Texas, was made by the same company, Shelby Electric. The [Centennial Bulb](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgyzxa&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) was hooked up to its own power source in 1976, and has lost power only once since then, for a little under 10 hours. Leaving it on 24/7 may have actually contributed to its longevity, since turning a bulb on and off frequently can damage the filament. The bulb also now burns at a steady 4 watts, much lower than its original 60 watts.

## Planned obsolescence started with lightbulbs.
The Centennial Bulb’s lifespan is impressive, but there’s a reason few bulbs have come close. “Planned obsolescence” is the practice of designing products to need replacing. Today, we see it everywhere, especially in technology such as the latest smartphones, but it dates back about 100 years. In the mid-1920s, decades after the Centennial Light first switched on, an industry group called Phoebus engineered a 1,000-hour lifespan for incandescent bulbs so households would have to replace them more frequently. That money-making strategy became the standard from then on.

clean_body: Technology such as LED lighting has made lightbulbs last longer than ever, but no modern bulb even comes close to the incandescent Centennial Light, which has been glowing inside a fire station in the San Francisco Bay Area since 1901. | T echnology such as LED lighting has made lightbulbs last longer than ever, but no modern bulb even comes close to the incandescent Centennial Light, which has been glowing inside a fire station in the San Francisco Bay Area since 1901. The light shines for 24 hours a day, though it has taken a few breaks here and there for power outages, renovations, and venue changes. It was first installed in a cart house — so named when fire hoses traveled on carts, not trucks — but moved to a large firehouse nearby soon after. In 1903, it moved again to a newly built station. It stayed there until 1976, when it moved to its present home in Livermore, California. At that point the bulb had been operational for 75 years, and had become a sensation; it even got a police and fire truck escort for the journey, which was slightly less than 2 miles. Unsurprisingly, the bulb’s survival probably boils down to good craftsmanship. The thick glass was hand-blown, and the bulb has a thick, durable carbon filament, unlike the thin tungsten filaments that became standard later. That was all mounted by hand on a sturdy brass base. Additionally, it’s filled with nitrogen gas, which is gentler than the argon and krypton gas used in later incandescents. The second longest burning lightbulb, located in Fort Worth, Texas, was made by the same company, Shelby Electric. The was hooked up to its own power source in 1976, and has lost power only once since then, for a little under 10 hours. Leaving it on 24/7 may have actually contributed to its longevity, since turning a bulb on and off frequently can damage the filament. The bulb also now burns at a steady 4 watts, much lower than its original 60 watts. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Livestreaming cameras outlived by the Centennial Bulb 3 | | Year the second longest burning lightbulb flicked on 1908 | Year the second longest burning lightbulb flicked on 1908 | | Portion of U.S. households that used all or mostly LED lighting in 2022 47% | | Approximate lumens of a 60-watt incandescent bulb 800 | Approximate lumens of a 60-watt incandescent bulb 800 | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- Planned obsolescence started with lightbulbs. The Centennial Bulb’s lifespan is impressive, but there’s a reason few bulbs have come close. “Planned obsolescence” is the practice of designing products to need replacing. Today, we see it everywhere, especially in technology such as the latest smartphones, but it dates back about 100 years. In the mid-1920s, decades after the Centennial Light first switched on, an industry group called Phoebus engineered a 1,000-hour lifespan for incandescent bulbs so households would have to replace them more frequently. That money-making strategy became the standard from then on. name: Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: The history of capitalism and socialism
body:
In the past few years, we've seen a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and against capitalism.

| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=a4b7ee5d502548c69e37df193b2e899b&_e=rC2k-_aPdP76FQzLEONZfSfzvsesIe5eHFDaKUD9ijulbg_2vc8IGZF0-G1v4OYsAMSbNkB81-OoyOom1NMc6t5ja5H02sBaIYXyEM4aOEuabGjo8S1ZcWC3vz0DXAspTe2LbbpffVl0XYybbBRFyLEH-5qAl_uuJoeEUsLi20kQr1ClT_kcOurOuiutsiv-qALepnN9fIreYc_4eBR2-RF8qh42Ky6tbaJIoQQW6AmT2HIQCaA7W_xGTiceI9wH6JI2orxfm1YVd7kU23vB72IF1l1dB0xPbm8APbFjdeEwJ_TQOG6kNYxKWCHbD8Kj6DGZzcI53CNoDHfQ5i0SsM5R5twLQ0w9QDHusu01Rl7yQDP2yCa8qY9I4aohWIqkI2gjvSAi72rjBTHtrYN6nsV3EMAeXtLKlIZDoIs_8E4%3D)

| | Dear Friend, Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we've seen a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and against capitalism.
---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=a4b7ee5d502548c69e37df193b2e899b&_e=rC2k-_aPdP76FQzLEONZfSfzvsesIe5eHFDaKUD9ijulbg_2vc8IGZF0-G1v4OYsAMSbNkB81-OoyOom1NMc6t5ja5H02sBaIYXyEM4aOEuabGjo8S1ZcWC3vz0DXAspTe2LbbpffVl0XYybbBRFyLEH-5qAl_uuJoeEUsLi20kQr1ClT_kcOurOuiutsiv-qALepnN9fIreYc_4eBR2-RF8qh42Ky6tbaJIoQQW6AmT2HIQCaA7W_xGTiceI9wHHvq7J8IkrBmzI3Pafm-xeX5KeSChqTXEd6fNATeJNnWrzzjBlgA3ANKGJ3lRXJJz9O7BlyO20XwtRdWyz-UTAxU6KHBODFvVSBOf34tQiw8Ii6hueUv1AxI5c0tNgMJbCw0V8qJI0dh1ZaNFkoWtfzOSiRZUIsSrart9Cw5Cz58%3D)

| | **But do they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and capitalism?** This is _precisely_ why we put together this brand new eBook, **[_The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=a4b7ee5d502548c69e37df193b2e899b&_e=rC2k-_aPdP76FQzLEONZfSfzvsesIe5eHFDaKUD9ijulbg_2vc8IGZF0-G1v4OYsAMSbNkB81-OoyOom1NMc6t5ja5H02sBaIYXyEM4aOEuabGjo8S1ZcWC3vz0DXAspTe2LbbpffVl0XYybbBRFyLEH-5qAl_uuJoeEUsLi20kQr1ClT_kcOurOuiutsiv-qALepnN9fIreYc_4eBR2-RF8qh42Ky6tbaJIoQQW6AmT2HIQCaA7W_xGTiceI9wHcgnYRyny7MyjVnW6HRHFSMCv3y86QQnea6Nol6NKFm2FPUGk5FS_7PhcHYfCH_wdnuLG1bEsekF2djZxLbQkTcn7tgz_qfh3SNf4pGRGCR1lwL93iSzec9bU65unpR_Esy4AkoAZ-w3IXt8OAc-3x9_mYktoHY8ez038ouvDwrs%3D)**[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=a4b7ee5d502548c69e37df193b2e899b&_e=rC2k-_aPdP76FQzLEONZfSfzvsesIe5eHFDaKUD9ijulbg_2vc8IGZF0-G1v4OYsAMSbNkB81-OoyOom1NMc6t5ja5H02sBaIYXyEM4aOEuabGjo8S1ZcWC3vz0DXAspTe2LbbpffVl0XYybbBRFyLEH-5qAl_uuJoeEUsLi20kQr1ClT_kcOurOuiutsiv-qALepnN9fIreYc_4eBR2-RF8qh42Ky6tbaJIoQQW6AmT2HIQCaA7W_xGTiceI9wHi04a2PF_BJ3AvcawxHJ2UIcURtvDsRpEjv-jpyfSxA8f5MFJSUqK6I4yzM_XRK_MfMWCh5osmgo5Fso-DEMm6qIqemFRTf7JcT4RQI6IRa2DFZlVduBx-yFLusZt1rwrk8H7rrEaizhy2cHKvOdsxckWyliyFJknOGPjyl-Atrg%3D), from Hoover Institution senior fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson. This eBook consists of two papers--one from each scholar--written in conjunction with _The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and Free-Market Capitalism_. This project provides objective and scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and well-being. Kennedy Jr. is polling stronger than any third-party candidate has in decades ...as he saps support from both President Biden and former President Donald J. Trump, a new series of polls has found. ...But beneath the surface of that seeming stability, the surveys revealed how Mr. Kennedy, powered by social media and younger voters, has emerged as an unpredictable X factor in what would otherwise be a 2020 rematch. ... Two of the groups that Mr. Kennedy performed strongest within the surveys — voters under 30 (18 percent support) and Latinos (14 percent) — have traditionally been strong Democratic constituencies, unnerving some party strategists. ... Friend,

The SAVE Act passed the House and though it was blocked last night by Senate Democrats - IT'S NOT DEAD YET. Here are three facts you need to know:

**Fact #1:** Joe Biden has let 10 million illegal immigrants into this country and Democrats are registering them to vote in record numbers.

**Fact #2:** The SAVE Act is our last chance at saving our democracy. name: The Editors at Broad + Liberty
subject: Four years later, how is America's soul?
body:
News + editorial to start your week | Broad + Liberty Weekly Reads | | | |
---
| | | Good morning and welcome to _Broad + Liberty_ 's Weekly Reads.

[Subscribe to our daily email list](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e64b835a1a&e=b7b3eddce2) and get the best of _Broad + Liberty_ delivered straight to your inbox.
---
|
---
|
### **1.[The soul of America](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=470b691ee0&e=b7b3eddce2)**
_By Andy Bloom_
When announcing his candidacy for president in 2019, Joe Biden said, “We are in a battle for the soul of this nation.” In explaining the rationale for his campaign, he promised to restore America’s core values and unite the country by healing our divisions. Four years later, how is America’s soul? If there were any questions, an attempted assassination of former president Donald Trump at an outdoor rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, on July 13 answers any lingering doubts. Although Trump received only minor injuries, the bullet was millimeters from killing him. **Why It Matters.** As Biden’s mental and physical condition deteriorated in the plain view of voters, Democrats, and the compliant press told the public that behind closed doors, Biden was as sharp as ever. When videos showed a dazed and confused president, his press secretary gaslit the public, claiming they were “cheap fakes.” The debate on June 27, using rules determined entirely by Biden’s team, burst the bubble. It turns out that Fox News wasn’t faux, but CNN, MSNBC, and the rest of the fawning media had been gaslighting the public. After the Dominion Voting System case against Fox News, now let’s see the private conversations between CNN and MSNBC anchors – they knew. There was a massive conspiracy to hide the president’s condition from the public, and it almost worked. The assassination attempt halted talk of removing Biden from the ticket – for now. However,[ Biden’s condition, most likely Parkinsonism](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=d27e91d646&e=b7b3eddce2), is progressive and will only get worse. We don’t know when he’ll have the next episode. We do (or should) know that it will happen – and in the not-too-distant future. Biden’s most explicit promise to restore the soul of America was to unite the country by healing the divisions. And this is where he has failed most miserably. **[Continue Reading](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=04271cce3d&e=b7b3eddce2)**
---
|
---
|
### **2.[Trump, Rwanda and the dangers of political propaganda](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=d3e19820d4&e=b7b3eddce2)**

_By Christine Flowers_
It is an old childhood truism that “sticks and stones may break my bones, but names will never hurt me.” In the United States, where speech is protected with a constitutional and social ferocity like no other country in the world, this has always been the default position. We want strong, full-throated debates, and we don’t want to punish people for using language that offends. But sometimes, language crosses the line. Sometimes, and even our own jurisprudence recognizes this, language can incite violence. That’s one of the exceptions to the almost absolute protection for free speech. And then we have those situations where language is used not so much to incite as to dehumanize. And if you are no longer human, you are no longer protected against inhumanity. **Why It Matters. ** I write this not to compare what happened this weekend in Butler, Pa., to the Rwanda genocide. That would be a foolish use of my own words. Donald Trump is not dead, he survived an assassination attempt, and the killer was neutralized. We do not even yet know his motives, and it will likely be a while before we do. In the meantime, conspiracy theorists will weigh in with their tin foil hat opinions. I do not own any of those. But I am also not insensitive to the fact that the political climate has become dangerously heated over the last eight years. When Donald Trump was elected back in 2016, women, in particular, acted as if they had been ordered to purchase burkas, leave school, and keep their wombs open for rental. Minority groups started screaming about the revocation of rights, and we were told that everyone in the Trump administration was one level down from Satan. **[Continue Reading](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=168ed7d2db&e=b7b3eddce2)**
---
|
---
|
# **3\. Podcasts**
* [Larry Miller & The Philadelphia Black Vote – Pennsylvania Kitchen Table Politics](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a475951c31&e=b7b3eddce2)

---
|
---
|
# **4\. Lightning Round**
* **[Thom Nickels: Church and state — avoiding the political minefield at coffee hour](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=38116a3dbb&e=b7b3eddce2)**
* **[Richard Koenig: Hold the phone on cell bans in schools](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=d5d74695a1&e=b7b3eddce2)**
* **[Beth Ann Rosica: Sanctuary or not? The truth about Pennsylvania’s immigration policies](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2a1455efd4&e=b7b3eddce2)**
* **[Inmate-on-inmate assaults skyrocket 65 percent at Delco prison](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=705f0dd383&e=b7b3eddce2)**
* **[Jeff Hurvitz: Is the Secret Service failure symptomatic?](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=3a92ac0391&e=b7b3eddce2)**
* **[Kyle Sammin: Bob Casey’s ‘greedflation’ fable](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7226e88bde&e=b7b3eddce2)**

---
|
---
|
# **5\. What we're reading**
Teamsters at the RNC? Steamfitters? It’s not the Republican Party of yesteryear — nor does the Democratic Party resemble that old New Deal Coalition. As Dems have focused on weird culture issues and free trade, they’ve satisfied their donors but driven a lot of working folks across the aisle to the GOP. Tim Carney wrote last week in the _Washington Examiner_ about [the continuing political alignment in American politics](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=6aef2f3cc9&e=b7b3eddce2), and how Trump’s Republican party often includes people who were once at the heart of the Democratic coalition but are now forgotten.

clean_body: News + editorial to start your week | Broad + Liberty Weekly Reads | | | | | | | Good morning and welcome to Broad + Liberty 's Weekly Reads. and get the best of Broad + Liberty delivered straight to your inbox. | | 1. By Andy Bloom When announcing his candidacy for president in 2019, Joe Biden said, “We are in a battle for the soul of this nation.” In explaining the rationale for his campaign, he promised to restore America’s core values and unite the country by healing our divisions. Four years later, how is America’s soul? If there were any questions, an attempted assassination of former president Donald Trump at an outdoor rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, on July 13 answers any lingering doubts. Although Trump received only minor injuries, the bullet was millimeters from killing him. Why It Matters. As Biden’s mental and physical condition deteriorated in the plain view of voters, Democrats, and the compliant press told the public that behind closed doors, Biden was as sharp as ever. When videos showed a dazed and confused president, his press secretary gaslit the public, claiming they were “cheap fakes.” The debate on June 27, using rules determined entirely by Biden’s team, burst the bubble. It turns out that Fox News wasn’t faux, but CNN, MSNBC, and the rest of the fawning media had been gaslighting the public. After the Dominion Voting System case against Fox News, now let’s see the private conversations between CNN and MSNBC anchors – they knew. There was a massive conspiracy to hide the president’s condition from the public, and it almost worked. The assassination attempt halted talk of removing Biden from the ticket – for now. However,, is progressive and will only get worse. We don’t know when he’ll have the next episode. We do (or should) know that it will happen – and in the not-too-distant future. Biden’s most explicit promise to restore the soul of America was to unite the country by healing the divisions. And this is where he has failed most miserably. | | 2. By Christine Flowers It is an old childhood truism that “sticks and stones may break my bones, but names will never hurt me.” In the United States, where speech is protected with a constitutional and social ferocity like no other country in the world, this has always been the default position. We want strong, full-throated debates, and we don’t want to punish people for using language that offends. But sometimes, language crosses the line. Sometimes, and even our own jurisprudence recognizes this, language can incite violence. That’s one of the exceptions to the almost absolute protection for free speech. And then we have those situations where language is used not so much to incite as to dehumanize. And if you are no longer human, you are no longer protected against inhumanity. Why It Matters. I write this not to compare what happened this weekend in Butler, Pa., to the Rwanda genocide. That would be a foolish use of my own words. Donald Trump is not dead, he survived an assassination attempt, and the killer was neutralized. We do not even yet know his motives, and it will likely be a while before we do. In the meantime, conspiracy theorists will weigh in with their tin foil hat opinions. I do not own any of those. But I am also not insensitive to the fact that the political climate has become dangerously heated over the last eight years. When Donald Trump was elected back in 2016, women, in particular, acted as if they had been ordered to purchase burkas, leave school, and keep their wombs open for rental. Minority groups started screaming about the revocation of rights, and we were told that everyone in the Trump administration was one level down from Satan. | | 3\. Podcasts | | 4\. Lightning Round | | 5\. What we're reading Teamsters at the RNC? Steamfitters? It’s not the Republican Party of yesteryear — nor does the Democratic Party resemble that old New Deal Coalition. As Dems have focused on weird culture issues and free trade, they’ve satisfied their donors but driven a lot of working folks across the aisle to the GOP. This course seeks to reveal the key people, ideas, and aims of the modern Left and to provide solutions for defending the American way of life today.

Hey there,
In October 2021, I had been an employee of Kellogg’s for almost 18 years.
I had dropped out of college and gone to work for the company after my wife got pregnant. Life’s easy when all you gotta do is take care of yourself – but we had diapers to buy and needed health insurance for our growing family.
When I applied in 2004, there were 6 positions and 600 applications. Working at Kellogg’s promised to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that afforded me the opportunity to become a homeowner, let my wife stay home with the kids, live decently, retire some day, and hopefully live happily ever after.
But over the years, wages became a two-tier system. New workers were being paid less than workers had made decades earlier. Cost of living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans had been gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers.
**So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89263575/486725709/92586991?refcode=em20240721am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=50355d2a-6147-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MDM1NWQyYS02MTQ3LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Zr_93YI6nShNcBbb3THOfcFp23lb_SutrJ9Ul0JCDBg=)
It was the first time many of us had ever walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines even through the dead of the winter if we had to. Every worker knew we were a part of something bigger than ourselves. We were in a fight for the future of the American middle class.
After 11 weeks, and the company threatening to permanently replace every union worker, we reached an agreement. More importantly, we saved 500 good-paying jobs here in Nebraska alone.
It was one of the proudest moments of my life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89263578/486725711/92586991?refcode=em20240721am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=50355d2a-6147-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MDM1NWQyYS02MTQ3LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Zr_93YI6nShNcBbb3THOfcFp23lb_SutrJ9Ul0JCDBg=)
Following the strike, I was fired. The company has its version of events for why, but I believe it was because I was union president. Someone had to pay – and my head was on the chopping block.
It’s easy to let yourself get beaten down by life. To let big corporations and the politicians they own in Washington make all the decisions – and just accept that that’s how things will always be. But that’s not me.
**Instead, I’ve decided to run against one of the most corporate politicians – U.S. Senator Republican Deb Fischer – and with your help, we are going to defeat her.**
A new poll shows just 24% of Nebraskan voters approve of Deb Fischer, and in that same poll, I am LEADING her by 2 points.
**I am ready to take on Republican Senator Deb Fischer just like I took on Kellogg’s. But I sure as hell am not going to take money from corporate PACs, so I need grassroots donors like you to give now if we’re going to win this Senate seat.**

1️⃣ **_Get involved:_ Check out in-person and virtual volunteer opportunities**
With the election only a few months away, every day counts and Democrats in states nationwide are counting on your support. [Find an opportunity to get involved here → ](https://an.dlcc.org/ss/c/u001.yjJN_MEbNx94PLaWzZ6hWxZOGvyrvb3uYDI_eCkdGdOkE3QAdlJUPtmRSWP8cs1clGUnpB9dW8o26sQuPS1amwPQsVDOTIcMs3SIIJ22tHIQ7ByCyLywN5GZHqMLXDO9ba_O5JqgisxhZh-8Uwn_gh_Xr2c0suiRM6_8Zf2oTR1Qjqyo6G7-3L0Q8HkNnp0jIrIXF3_4mGDlaBdSG-aKA0NRMper9l9dclsuvMKvS0bqcXbUs4gQDf-T8XWlD8JAZimpz8RId1xSXvlblFSIxYhABSYFrcaQcXczM4tAr_dzRHKAR6ViqhvRlVLqu-1xH5RmZeKSn8YI85_QQjoxv0B7H9ISXlb1VJmz5TSCYGy1zY5twJ51mBCbKMhP8YSAudFU2Yr68LfF4gOY-lenL0tVr1C4lLH3fEQeEjng7Wc3xRBw1XW3QYANBFvyDd-Pnb5telHbx8R0NZrGhj_XrlO3tyO1MECOm-yH4_LzgZdcVjS1WokXnhdYjDjf_95D/488/WF_Aiq5xQm6th0K5mj69eA/h1/h001.5ncnrZxCg-Y-EhFha35ixpPBI632FZK9seVPL0ZCnmc)
2️⃣ **_We want your input:_ Do you approve of the Supreme Court? **
Recent rulings have raised questions about the ultra-conservative Supreme Court. From limiting prosecution against insurrectionists to granting Trump immunity for official acts, there’s a lot to digest. [**We value your opinion, will you take a moment to share your thoughts in our quick poll?**](https://an.dlcc.org/ss/c/u001.yjJN_MEbNx94PLaWzZ6hW5Lkp5lOCwikP-XCX5D9XT1Gs1NbmWdVuRjD_cXPBn3BeIr_xoSjj2VwnwyiYfNrHRLKoj4MKWZITPa740yqiCyoUz9ijonCZ50xb4J-yUxw1umKO6YtiyvXQN7usbOrao6GVjTTHvcVot6Pok030oaz9NWlwRAvS3PWUE7y_Sl9VvdWpexrGd8EPiLqBOdTc5QOA4xU4e4h_X8wl9qSLvzKtHwed7itCRL-F42ASlb-pCXRM18Oy_fo3VLVK5YodkVTtoKqlIafdz9TYnAZi9tXEVi7Y7z3V1i4K1yuEpj1ybYEDVm8EzG7pQC0cvNLVeXn5STiC-GkJ2E6Re0w0b_3ToyptEQbTFoVuYzHvqJFEgx413HTxXqbMAKN2Mzw1DsgJCbQx6r9ysqBRLCEYjsRep4fvmMXoA3KxwN1prnT9EjuQ0tfVwDLmS6fFdhkEFFHbwggr35tliaWPqb5Sfk0AbYiPZ78Ehqnrh4OtQO0Hy_9_sRk4kVIVgMeHOL9kw/488/WF_Aiq5xQm6th0K5mj69eA/h2/h001.lDT0W2NObQbyFcNBv1q_Y0oSKiCdhu_PdZ6nAO4zVz4)

I don't own a single individual stock, friend. No member of Congress should. Period.
That's why earlier this month, we unveiled a new bipartisan bill that builds off our proposal to ban congressional stock trading. **We're in Congress to serve the American people, not get rich from insider stock tips.**
I've always said that when you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work. That's my focus – every day.
But my millionaire opponent, Bernie Moreno, feels different. He's been fighting for himself and his rich friends his entire career. It's no wonder he's such a great ally and friend to Donald Trump and J.D. Vance.
MAGA Republicans know how hard I fight for workers' rights, so they're determined to flip my seat red – and the Senate – for their corporate interests.
But we can't let them. Our Senate majority is on the line. I need your help to fight back against the GOP super PACs spending record amounts of money to attack me in Ohio.
Unlike my self-funding opponent, I'm not a rich guy. I don't own stocks, and I don't have millions of dollars to give my campaign. But I have you and this incredible group of grassroots supporters.
**[That's why I'm personally asking, friend: Will you chip in $5 or more to help me continue to stand up for the Dignity of Work in the U.S. Senate?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89265269/486729740/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk2275-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMjdhY2ZkYi02MTQ3LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5ott1e7paTBRCFqcxLDeiIxByFRqUG-XRjdxFLUvmrM=)**

**Please read on for a personal message from Sen. Sherrod Brown:** Friend – thank you for being a part of our grassroots movement and for sharing our commitment to the Dignity of Work. Fighting for workers means building an economy that prioritizes the needs of workers over tax breaks for billionaires and corporations. Hi Peter,
I wanted to write to you about why I have devoted my career to service and why I’m running for re-election.
**Pennsylvania is my home, and I’m proud to serve in the U.S. Senate and fight for the people of our Commonwealth.** I’m running to continue making progress in the fight for workers’ rights, women’s rights, and voting rights. I’m working for our seniors, veterans, and working families. We’ve achieved important wins that will make a real difference, investing in Pennsylvania and putting money back into people’s pockets.
But there are fights we still must win.
**Right now, Mitch McConnell and out-of-state billionaires are spending millions of dollars in dark money to take back the Senate.** They’ve made unseating me one of their top priorities — and to stop them, I’ll need all the help I can get.
Here in Pennsylvania, we strive to be a Commonwealth in life as well as in name. That means we face our biggest challenges head-on, and we face them together, as a community.

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1673%2E135344%2E9u71qt)

Last night, Donald Trump visited Michigan to rally his supporters, weeks before the Republican Senate primary. It was his 7th visit in less than 13 months because he knows he can’t win the White House – and Republicans can’t flip the Senate – without winning Michigan.
Elissa needs your help to keep Michigan blue in November. Please, use this link to donate now:
[**https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/Keep-MI-Blue**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240721-1-900k&t=2&akid=1673%2E135344%2E9u71qt)
This was Trump’s first stop since announcing JD Vance as his running mate. Michigan is an interesting choice for this event, given that no self-respecting Michigander would vote for a Buckeye.
But even though he was campaigning with an Ohioan, this visit does make it clear that Trump and his team are doubling down on Michigan, and that winning the presidential and the Senate race here are top priorities.
Trump also invited Mike Rogers on stage — along with fellow Republican candidate Sandy Pensler, who announced during the rally that he was dropping out and endorsing Mike Rogers. The Republican Senate primary won’t be settled until August 6th, but this endorsement sends a signal to voters to get in line behind Trump’s hand-picked candidates.
All of this is an indication that Republicans are gearing up to throw everything they can at Michigan, and that Michigan Democrats can’t take anything for granted.

When people work together, progress is possible.

I am sure you heard the news that another Republican has withdrawn from this race for the United States Senate.
As I wrote you earlier this year, there has been a lot of arm twisting from the insiders to clear the field for Mike Rogers. They know he is a flexible Republican.
I am not!
And I am not going anywhere! I am committed to winning this race.
We are not going to fix our country by electing RINOs who worked for CNN. We need true conservatives in DC who want to stop the invasion, protect our rights, balance the budget, end inflation, oppose funding the Ukraine war, and support Israel. I am that candidate!
I have the most aggressive plan to end illegal immigration. I am the only candidate who has signed both the term limits and no new taxes pledge. I am the candidate with the plan to put government spending on a diet. I am the only candidate who has pledged to serve on the Election Integrity Caucus. And I am the only candidate who is even talking about cleaning up Congress by stopping all the insider trading.
We have less than 3 weeks to go.
I am the alternative candidate to the RINO!

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89274605/486752163/1380915657?amount=10&amounts=10,25,50,100,250&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2024.07.21_PERSONALSTORY_B1_F1_S1_C1_u1_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzgwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYWUzZDdmMy02OTQ3LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KlI2p3xMV3tmUtQqI4GrWHlbsguK0UVOD4hZUJMrQN0=) Hi, Peter. Joyce Craig here.

I’m reaching out to share my personal experience with reproductive healthcare and why I’ll never stop fighting to ensure all Granite Staters have access to the care they need.

This is a bit of a longer read, so if you’re short on time, [ please consider chipping in to my grassroots campaign for Governor so we can defend reproductive rights here in New Hampshire.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89274609/486752167/43219686?amount=10&amounts=10,25,50,100,250&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2024.07.21_PERSONALSTORY_B1_F1_S1_C1_u1_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzgwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYWUzZDdmMy02OTQ3LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KlI2p3xMV3tmUtQqI4GrWHlbsguK0UVOD4hZUJMrQN0=)

After having our first two children, my husband Mike and I decided to grow our family again.

I suspected something was wrong during my pregnancy. I remember that feeling during my ultrasound when the nurse kept shifting positions, trying to find a heartbeat. It never came and my doctor confirmed that I had miscarried.

Mike and I were devastated. Those plans for the future had to be put away, and I had to make the decision on how to move forward. What I took for granted at the time was that I had the ability to have a D&C procedure and end my pregnancy without interference.

Nearly 25 percent of pregnancies end in miscarriage, and _Roe v. Wade_ protected our right to decide how to end these pregnancies with our doctors and provided every woman the right to bodily autonomy. That is no longer the case in many states, and ever since the _Dobbs_ decision, our reproductive rights have been in jeopardy.

Here in New Hampshire, Republicans have proposed 15-week and even 15-day abortion bans. These extreme restrictions threaten our right to privacy. We cannot take our rights for granted. Because of the _Dobbs_ decision, they can be taken away by extreme anti-choice legislators.

**I’m running for Governor of New Hampshire because I believe these decisions belong to women, not politicians.** But right now, New Hampshire is the only state in New England that does not have a law protecting access to abortion.

subject: A longer message about what this movement is fighting for and why I need you to be part of it.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
#
Peter,
I’m running for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat because I want to put everyday people in charge of our country — not giant corporations or the cowards like Josh Hawley they’ve bought off in Washington.
**This email is longer than usual, but I wanted to take some time this morning to explain what this movement is fighting for and why I need you to be part of it.** Please let me explain:
**[CHIP IN NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59712?refcode=em20240721-7133&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7133%2E614464%2E4YelT6)**
**When I came home between deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan, it was clear to me that Missouri is on the frontlines of the fight for power in our country.**
While communities like mine all across our state were stripped for parts, corrupt politicians like Josh Hawley attacked workers with anti-union schemes like “Right-to-Work” and fought to block wage increases for Missouri families — all to enrich multinational corporations and mega-donors who bankroll their campaigns and their careers.
They helped Wall Street financiers sell off our farmland to billionaires in China and Brazil — devastating rural communities and contributing to the closure of 90% of Missouri hog producers in a single generation.
One of Missouri’s oldest and largest employers, Anheuser-Busch, was sold to a Belgian conglomerate — costing Missouri more than a thousand jobs.
Missouri-based Monsanto, one of the world’s most important agrochemical and biotechnology companies, was sold to Germany — eliminating even more jobs.
And as dozens more headquarters were taken out of state, politicians in power like Josh Hawley were happy to sit back and watch it happen.
**Manufacturing, agriculture, production — they’re shipping it all away to foreign oligarchs who don’t care about working people in our state.** And while our communities were being gutted, these same politicians voted time and time again to spend trillions of dollars and thousands of lives on overseas wars that got their Big Oil friends rich.
These politicians have spent decades sparking phony culture wars to distract and divide our families. They’ve become so obsessed with controlling our lives, they made Missouri the first state in the nation to ban abortion — without exceptions.
**Our state deserves a Senator who will stand up and fight for it — and I’m ready to serve.[So if you’re ready to elect a real warrior for working people to Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, will you please rush a donation of any amount toward our grassroots campaign today?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59712?refcode=em20240721-7133&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7133%2E614464%2E4YelT6)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59713?refcode=em20240721-7133&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=3&akid=7133%2E614464%2E4YelT6) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59713?refcode=em20240721-7133&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=4&akid=7133%2E614464%2E4YelT6) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59712?refcode=em20240721-7133&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7133%2E614464%2E4YelT6)
---
We aren’t fighting the corporate status quo just to make a point, either. **This is a race we really can win.**
Our values have won at the ballot box in Missouri for referendums that go beyond what’s happening nowadays in Washington, or even what political elites in Jefferson City are willing to allow.
For the last three election cycles, Missouri voters have side-stepped our politicians by voting to increase the minimum wage well above the federal level, expand health care, repeal an anti-worker “Right-to-Work” scheme, legalize weed, and enact more protections against political corruption with wide margins.
**So now, we’re building a record-breaking, people-powered movement to defeat Josh Hawley and take this Senate seat back for working Missourians.**
Together, we’re going to stop printing money for Wall Street and start funding our schools enough to get Missouri out of last place for starting teacher pay.
We’re going to abolish corporate PACs and demand a government that safeguards our democracy and holds corrupt politicians accountable.
We’re going to take back Missouri farmland for Missouri farmers and start manufacturing essential medications right here in America.
We’re going to build an economy that puts American workers and small businesses in charge, not giant corporations and foreign oligarchs — an economy that invests in putting America first in the next generation of energy, semiconductors, and supply chain independence.
We’re going to put an end to pointless, trillion-dollar wars and invest in a Marshall Plan for the Midwest — a historic investment in our workers and communities to rebuild our forgotten towns and cities, and to finally start making stuff in America again.
And we’re going to finally put everyday Missourians in charge of their own neighborhoods, workplaces, and bodies.
**It’s time to take our power back — and we can’t do it without your support.[So please, will you rush a donation of absolutely any amount toward my grassroots campaign today? I’m not taking a cent from corporate PACs in this race, so you’ll always know I’m fighting for everyday, working people in the U.S. Senate.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59712?refcode=em20240721-7133&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=7133%2E614464%2E4YelT6)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59713?refcode=em20240721-7133&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=7&akid=7133%2E614464%2E4YelT6) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59713?refcode=em20240721-7133&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=8&akid=7133%2E614464%2E4YelT6) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59713?refcode=em20240721-7133&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=9&akid=7133%2E614464%2E4YelT6) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59713?refcode=em20240721-7133&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=10&akid=7133%2E614464%2E4YelT6) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59713?refcode=em20240721-7133&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=11&akid=7133%2E614464%2E4YelT6) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59713?refcode=em20240721-7133&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=12&akid=7133%2E614464%2E4YelT6) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59712?refcode=em20240721-7133&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=13&akid=7133%2E614464%2E4YelT6)
---
Thank you for everything, Peter.
Now let’s get moving,
Lucas

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lk-email-footer?refcode=em20240721-7133-footer&t=14&refcode2=7133_614464_4YelT6&akid=7133%2E614464%2E4YelT6)**

## Showing up for Alaska in Milwaukee

Dear Friends,

I've just returned from the 2024 RNC Convention in Milwaukee, and it was an incredible experience! We had the honor of nominating our once and future president, Donald J. Trump. It was truly inspiring to be surrounded by dedicated Republicans who are ready to take our country back.

Being at the convention allowed me to connect with many of my future colleagues in Congress, advocating for Alaska's unique needs and opportunities on a national stage. I took every chance to highlight Alaska's critical role in national security, resource development, and energy independence to local, national, and international media. It was essential to ensure that our voices were heard and that our state’s importance was recognized.

One of the key messages from the convention was the importance of unifying our party. We must stand together to ensure victory in November. This unity is crucial not just for the party, but for the future of our nation. But before we get there, we have a crucial primary in August. Make sure your voice is heard—don't forget to cast your vote on August 20th!

If you believe in our mission, please consider making a donation to our campaign. Your contribution, no matter the size, will help us reach more Alaskans and spread our message of a brighter future.

As your candidate for Congress, I promise to bring the dedication and work ethic that Alaska deserves. But I can't do it without you, and your support. Please [_**click here**_](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=6095385475&e=6679001ba0) to make a contribution. Your financial support is much-needed, greatly appreciated — and we'll put it to the best possible use: taking Alaska's seat back!

Best regards,

Nick Begich

P.S. Stay tuned for more updates and ways to get involved in our campaign! Your involvement is more important than ever.

clean_body: Proud to participate in a historic convention! | | | | | | | | | | Showing up for Alaska in Milwaukee Dear Friends, I've just returned from the 2024 RNC Convention in Milwaukee, and it was an incredible experience! We had the honor of nominating our once and future president, Donald J. Trump. It was truly inspiring to be surrounded by dedicated Republicans who are ready to take our country back. Being at the convention allowed me to connect with many of my future colleagues in Congress, advocating for Alaska's unique needs and opportunities on a national stage. I took every chance to highlight Alaska's critical role in national security, resource development, and energy independence to local, national, and international media. It was essential to ensure that our voices were heard and that our state’s importance was recognized. One of the key messages from the convention was the importance of unifying our party. We must stand together to ensure victory in November. This unity is crucial not just for the party, but for the future of our nation. But before we get there, we have a crucial primary in August. Make sure your voice is heard—don't forget to cast your vote on August 20th! If you believe in our mission, please consider making a donation to our campaign. Your contribution, no matter the size, will help us reach more Alaskans and spread our message of a brighter future. As your candidate for Congress, I promise to bring the dedication and work ethic that Alaska deserves. But I can't do it without you, and your support. Please to make a contribution. Your financial support is much-needed, greatly appreciated — and we'll put it to the best possible use: taking Alaska's seat back! Best regards, Nick Begich P.S. Stay tuned for more updates and ways to get involved in our campaign! With ballots for Michigan’s August 6th primary election already mailed out to voters, every day is Election Day for the next two weeks. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEWOEhdKR9ONqt46mSMkp045py10MXgbeClfPpuimSkcjhWu22vdUu_YrsWVWWKp7HPJHWam-2bW2vQgUC8Zm8D9VAv2Q2tUC6bHNDS43A_U4ujqaKzFl_v2ucvvN_I-AWhVRXsXySFGE5eV0jqpZTP3HWPzPLcnnVPN8ZQpZj83HPLMaXR5zKsZl4SPGhxwAaP7V8GLAu-BvpEbNDcF7tMGw/488/dxECZw8NTRyGGCzVHBSk6A/h0/h001.A06JUWALiPO_zcSKsb8WslB5ILnknIaNawL__MKgQHQ)

We must take mega-spending from MAGA extremists seriously to protect our movement.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240721-4125-footer&t=1&akid=4125%2E420207%2EXB5hST)
Peter, this is a bit of a longer email, but I hope you’ll stick around to the end.
**We must take mega-spending from MAGA extremists seriously to protect our movement.**
**We cannot afford to lose momentum, slow down our fundraising efforts, or stop growing this movement.** Now more than ever, we must dig deep and show the GOP what we stand for.
There’s no question that the far-right feels emboldened in their plans to unseat progressives. And they’re going to try this same tactic on other progressives across the country — **and our campaign has been on their target list before.**
I’ve got three challengers running against me this time — and I can’t afford to take any chances. Dark money Super PACs have polled nasty attacks against me and I know they’re gearing up to try and beat our campaign. That’s why I’m asking you to help me kick our campaign into high-gear, Peter. We can and will stand up to dark money spending, and we _will_ win our race with you on our side.
In just over two weeks, our campaign will face our primary election — and this is our _final_ opportunity to fortify our resources before the GOP’s donors turn their sights on us.
I’ve never taken a dime of corporate PAC money and I never will. My campaign is funded through tens of thousands of grassroots donors like you. Now, I need all hands on deck to fortify our resources before August 6th so that we can keep fighting at full power while protecting our hard-earned progress. **Can I personally ask you to help our campaign with a donation of any amount made to the link below?**

name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Intel
subject: The Battle for Truth
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsZ-vUuWbN
Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its
media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osZ-vUuWbN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Fellow
American,

Over the
last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and
Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together,
these forces want to circumvent the First Amendment, suppress
conservative speech and political activity, and push their own
false and dishonest narrative about American history and about
what's happening today.

More and
more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are
dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative
opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

We have
never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

The roots
of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when
radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking
over our colleges and universities.

It took
them several decades to cement their dominance over American
higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors
today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are
also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America-much
of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands-and increasingly
in K-12 education.

Liberty
in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the
country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this
crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the
fight may seem.

A vital
part of the fight-and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely
able to lead-is to reach and teach additional millions of
citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of
liberty.

You are
making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach
efforts, such as Imprimis, America's leading digest of liberty.

Hillsdale
launched Imprimis over 50 years ago to promote limited
government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal
responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers
a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a
constitutional perspective.

Today,
with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free
speech and informed patriotism, Imprimis is more critical than
ever.

Think of
what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and
unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and
even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of
this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off
any debate about these issues-an effort to limit or curtail
speech that is simply and clearly un-American.

There is
a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says
Imprimis is the publication he most looks forward to reading each
month.

You'll be
pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more
than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are mailed
to homes and businesses ten times per year.

Our
research also shows that Imprimis subscribers share their copy
with two to three other people on average, giving Imprimis even
greater reach and influence.

And while
a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly
impressive-Imprimis has a greater circulation than the Wall
Street Journal and The New York Times-we are determined to do
more.

Since
Imprimis launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000,
Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.

But the
fact that we offer Imprimis free of charge does not mean that
producing and mailing Imprimis is without cost.

Even
using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and
mailing each issue of Imprimis to so many subscribers ten times a
year is a significant financial undertaking.

Our
immediate goal is to increase the circulation of Imprimis to over
7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so,
we must address the question of production and mailing costs.

Your
generous support today will help us reach our Imprimis goal and
expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know
that education is liberty's surest defense-and that education is
needed now more than ever!

That's
why, in addition to Imprimis, we are investing in our other
educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing
this through our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching
and Teaching Millions.

These
efforts include:

Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans,
through free online courses-on topics including the Constitution,
American history, and free-market economics.

Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free
copies of the Declaration of Independence and

Every semester while I worked as a TA, I gave students the opportunity to earn extra credit by writing an essay about the scientific accuracy of a disaster film.
Some chose to have fun with the assignment, breaking down the lunacy of films like "Sharknado," while others took on more serious and accurate films, like "Bølgen" ("The Wave").
One of the more popular films chosen each semester was the 1996 classic "Twister."
Now that the much-anticipated sequel is out, nearly 30 years later, the obvious question is: _how accurate is it?_
