July 21, 2024
Jim Himes made a big media slash when he [visited South and Central America](https://substack.com/redirect/5d79ab5c-15b0-4e45-bca4-e45460aa3cbd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in 2019 to investigate illegal drugs entering the United States stating:

"It's not just cocaine coming into the US through shipping containers and fast boats; it's also Fentanyl, which is deadly on its own and sometimes cut into cocaine. The drug pipeline from Colombia into the US and, eventually, Connecticut, touches on many of the major issues our country is facing today - border security, the opioid epidemic, and national security - and we must dedicate the necessary resources to help combat it while reducing demand at home."
Once Biden was elected and instituted an open border policy allowing fentanyl-bearing illegals to flood the country, Himes did a Gilda Ratner and said "Never mind."
Meanwhile [thousands of Connecticut citizens](https://substack.com/redirect/2550ee49-0620-40ca-a21c-f87a1bda0a98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are dying of drug overdoses while Himes backs Biden's policies.
Mike Goldstein will change this. Here are his thoughts on the Fentanyl epidemic.
**[Charging Dealers Who Sell Fatal Doses of Fentanyl With Murder](https://substack.com/redirect/f1486f09-35a9-403f-b7b1-197a7fbadaa0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Reducing fentanyl deaths
| [](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F3d226123-93bb-4100-96e3-6335a5aa3ecb_400x400.jpeg)|
---|---|---
**[DR. MICHAEL GOLDSTEIN](https://substack.com/@drmichaelgoldsteinct)**
* * *
> Sales of fentanyl are exploding in the US. In 2021 11.5 million pills containing fentanyl were seized by 2023 over 115 million were seized by law enforcement. Over 80,000 people died from opioids in 2022 the majority from fentanyl. Many were buying what they thought were oxycodone or benzodiazepines but instead were counterfeit pills laced with fatal doses of fentanyl. One pill and they were dead. The Federal law needs to be changed so that anyone involved in the manufacturing, distribution or sales of fentanyl or fentanyl like pills that contain fatal doses of the drug that result in death are guilty of murder and should be charged with murder, and or conspiracy to commit murder. Federal law should also be changed so that when fentanyl is seized it should be tested if any of the pills contain a fatal dose of fentanyl they are guilty of attempted murder.
> This will not keep the drugs off the street but it will act as a deterrent to prevent the manufacture and sale of pills containing fatal doses of fentanyl. It will save lives.

Most of my family is from a town in Missouri called Ste. Genevieve, about 60 miles south of St. Louis. I’ve watched their community go downhill for years.
While corrupt politicians shipped jobs overseas and voted to give handouts to Wall Street and their corporate allies, everyday people just trying to survive in the place they call home ran out of money and opportunities.
**Our leaders abandoned them — and Josh Hawley is the perfect example.**
Instead of fighting for what would make the communities in my home state stronger, Josh Hawley has been busy engaging in the out-of-touch culture wars that only divide us — all so he can get more and more power for himself.
That’s what we saw on January 6th, 2021. Hawley raised his fist at rioters outside the Capitol because he thought it would make himself look strong. But when sh*t got real, he ran out the back door like a coward — away from the same people he was claiming to support just hours earlier.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89284376/486779597/-228879582?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk2635-bu-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MjIzZWE0Zi03YTQ3LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=u712H0xYuDAH2n1ZChspsZkxZOgacVK9nxclxI_e7Hg=)
Well... when I think about manhood, I think about courage. And that’s not something you can write a book about.
Missouri is the Show Me State. Courage is something you have to show us.
**That’s why I’m supporting Lucas Kunce for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.** As a born-and-raised Missourian who joined the Marines to serve the community that took care of him growing up, Lucas has already shown us that he knows the true meaning of courage.
Lucas knows courage is about standing up to the powerful and working to rebuild our state. And he knows real leaders fight to empower everyday people and secure our future for generations to come — not for their own power or profit.

At the RNC last week, the GOP sent us a message here in Arizona.
They think Arizona is already theirs. They’re convinced — they truly believe — that they have already won here. The pundits and the political elites are writing us off, and our opponents are getting cocky.

A one-on-one matchup with Adam Schiff on November 5th. **[**Can I count on your contribution of $6 to help defeat Adam Schiff today?**](http://links.thegopreport.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=9c6fcf50dade4ab5962b81d61e81b3e1&_e=j5oKwHNkpP4x6kbq7kuZ3IRmR2D8OGBKV7Mz529ee8ZzGIQyelIetbaJYHzriz4XUnyXkvFwZDjVciP-AP5eguP0XRfLNwy3bZnWUhi9yi4aXaJbrebie305aANQXRvStfZUiqQpUh4gMjiM26MjcmfqclCh4pb0WQ3tXCtDH55UkH3KmXWxgWaCeVcPnIQxrwI7zn5HbBEJ3sXK4hm7vpgb7OLUXCdNMguibtJwxLKVST3hk22S_OeB0bVpm1inuNw2EwzJUwx5SgmFGpyn2bk0yYJxOQlE404TFZXy6x5fLa7B217fOWhdRBrggLPk4Oom1P6rUg7-FldjJUra8omr4DxkBOe9qm2zNrZoSVzpM6gWP9Z1Owk3hOlUrOxBf982tIc8BDhhLKfkyTkZIg%3D%3D)** You see, Adam Schiff's enablers in the corporate media are already spreading the lie that this race is over. They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they'd rather face me: **_Be careful what you wish for._** I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. **[That said, I must ask: will you rush a contribution to my senate campaign today?](http://links.thegopreport.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=9c6fcf50dade4ab5962b81d61e81b3e1&_e=j5oKwHNkpP4x6kbq7kuZ3IRmR2D8OGBKV7Mz529ee8ZzGIQyelIetbaJYHzriz4XUnyXkvFwZDjVciP-AP5eguP0XRfLNwy3bZnWUhi9yi4aXaJbrebie305aANQXRvStfZUiqQpUh4gMjiM26MjcmfqclCh4pb0WQ3tXCtDH55UkH3KmXWxgWaCeVcPnIQxrwI7zn5HbBEJ3sXK4hm7vpgb7OLUXCdNMguibtJwxLKVST3hk22S_OeB0bVpm1infy6FcEHYzgccXHl-6NDHaf5XVQLrQe97voXMC0Z-GV5aAHbn85X7hlbuU2md0w_1G0Fx0Fq8sg-uzgArQsnMkmIuy5SCa6aAK5SD9YYnXD3W4C-aCYOX8ebcWtRfCGVGxE6DFviXS2d1QPfl2h2R0A%3D%3D) ** This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you!

Today I achieve the meaning of life. For the Hitchhiker Guide to the Galaxy fans, you know exactly what I mean. I turn 42. A little more grey in my beard. A little more dad bod around the waist. And hopefully a little more wisdom picked up along the way.
I want to thank you all for your continued support of my advocacy for human rights and justice. Today I'll make my one birthday ask of you, that if you were thinking about investing in _Let 's Address This_ as a paid subscriber, I would cherish the trust and partnership today. [Can we earn 420 new subscribers today](https://substack.com/@qasimrashid)? Let's go!
As an immigrant, as someone who grew up in Section 8 housing and on food stamps, and as someone who has had the good fortune to build a platform committed to justice--I consider myself incredibly fortunate and blessed. And so, I ask myself, what I would tell my 22-year-old self if I could go back in time and speak with him?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/74c790be-4ee2-4949-bb7e-1f3e3846103b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

## 11 Life Lessons
I'm sure this list may change in the future with added wisdom. For now, I present the "_always do_ " and "_never do_ " things I would tell my younger self...and I hope you might find inspiration from it as well.
1. Always remember to cut yourself slack and lift yourself up. Plenty of folks will try to tear you down--don't join them. Be your own biggest champion because sometimes you're all you're gonna have, and you should know that you're enough.
2. Always cherish the moment, not the destination you're seeking. The destination may come, or it might not. But that moment is here and what you'll miss the most. A movie night. A laugh in class. A snowball fight. Cherish it.
3. Always say yes when a friend calls you for lunch or coffee. Always. The older you get the more you'll realize that "no" you gave was the last time you ever spoke.
4. And after saying yes to lunch, always pay for lunch. Don't make a big deal out of it. People remember when you do something kind that you don't have to do.
5. And after doing something nice, never remind someone you did them a favor. Ever. No matter how small or large, do the favor because it needed to be done, not because you expected some kind of reward or recognition or leverage.
6. Always protect the privacy and dignity of your life partner. Find someone who complements you and compliments you. Someone you can be vulnerable to.
7. Always treat your children with impeccable respect, especially when they screw up. How you treat them is how they'll normalize the world treating them. If they feel respected, they'll respect others, and they'll command respect of others.
8. Never let your anger decide your decision making. Speak and act soberly. There's an old adage, "Whenever you speak, speak sweetly, so if you have to eat your words, you have a tasty treat."
9. Always act to change injustice with your actions. And if you can't, then speak out against it with your words. And if you can't, then steel yourself against its influence.
10. Always write down when you lend a friend or loved one money. Even your closest family. And even then, lend with the intent that if they can't repay you (because life happens), you'll forget about it. Cherish people more than money.
11. Finally, always remember the difference between disappointment and regret. You can be disappointed you didn't achieve some goal despite your best efforts, but regret comes from not giving your best efforts. Live a life of conviction, committed to justice, compassion, and love--and you'll live a life of no regrets.

A shout out to my amazing wife Ayesha, without whom I cannot fathom how much of a failure I would have been. If there's anything I've written or said that you appreciate, [credit goes to her](https://substack.com/redirect/1f925313-4f76-4f44-abd9-5d45bde0c8bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Much love to all y'all for your amazing and ongoing love and support as well!
Here's to the next 42 years and beyond, inshaAllah! Peace

I answered the same questions as the other two, in real time. And I brought onto the stage with me THE ISSUES we really need to be talking about. The corruption in Washington which thrived under both Presidents Biden and Trump. The widening wealth gap. The endless wars. The chronic disease epidemic. The assault on our rights and freedoms. The destruction of the middle class. Those are the issues I’ll address when I make it to Washington, D.C. This debate has opened a wide door for my candidacy. Nadarius wasn’t willing to sit around and wait years for a Democratic governor with a spine to replace the NRA-backed Republican currently in office, so he started thinking about what he could get done under the current circumstances. Look, I get it — this may not be everything we wanted, but if even one life is saved as a result of this bill, it was worth it. And you can bet that when the current NRA-backed governor is replaced with a Democrat who’s willing to keep our communities safe, Nadarius will be there leading the charge to do even more. What makes all this even more impressive is that Nadarius is the youngest person serving in the Virginia legislature, and his district is the most competitive in the entire state. Last year we gave Nadarius’ campaign about $100,000, and he won by just about 800 votes. That secured a 1 seat majority in the House of Delegates which enabled him to pass this law and kill a separate GOP bill that sought to arm teachers. It’s clear to me that this work is making a difference — but as a grassroots organization that doesn’t take corporate donations, we’re counting on your support to keep going. OFFICIAL STATEMENT
Sun. July 21, 2024
As President Joe Biden makes the decision to complete his term and step down from the 2024 ticket, I want to express my deep, heartfelt gratitude for his years of selfless public service.
"Joe Biden has always put service above himself, showing what real leadership means. He has worked tirelessly to ensure everyone's voice is heard, striving to improve the economy, enhance healthcare, and combat climate change.
"President Biden's efforts to bring people together give us hope, even when we don't always see eye to eye. He demonstrates his care for people, especially those in need. His collaboration with other countries has helped keep America strong, peaceful, and prosperous.
"I eagerly await the emergence of the candidate at the top of the ticket, but our mission endures. We must reaffirm our dedication to improving the lives of everyday, hardworking Americans. Change begins locally, and we are committed to helping Northern Michigan and the UP thrive.
"Thank you, Joe Biden, for your unwavering commitment to the American people and propelling our nation forward."
Bob Lorinser

Democrat, MI01

Four years ago, we had the LOWEST illegal border crossings in forty years. Unfortunately, the day President Joe Biden took office, he deserted his presidential duty to protect our country and keep our borders secure. _The result has been catastrophic. _

Under Joe Biden, illegal immigration has skyrocketed. Over _11 MILLION_ immigrants have crossed our borders illegally.

_**That 's more than the entire population of Michigan.

It's twice the population of Wisconsin.**_

Through his open border policies, Joe Biden has welcomed into our country rapists, murderers, and terrorists into communities across our nation.

Sadly, the price we've paid for these reckless policies has been deadly.

| | **For Immediate Release:** July 21, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Dave Min’s Statement on President Biden’s Decision**
**IRVINE, CA** —Dave Min made this statement following President Biden’s decision to exit the Presidential race:

**“I am grateful to President Biden for his decades of service to our country. The impacts of his life’s work, including his term as President, will be felt for generations to come. I am sure his decision to step aside was not an easy one, but it is one that is characteristic of his history of serving the public good. We must defeat Donald Trump and his radical agenda to ban abortion and overthrow our democracy, as well as the MAGA extremists who would promote this agenda, including my opponent Scott Baugh.”** ###

_California’s 47th is an open_[ _DCCC Red To Blue_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=d597a8524b&e=7017cc100e) _Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Democratic Representative Katie Porter is not running for re-election. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this_[ _“toss up”_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=5dd58b4f56&e=7017cc100e) _district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._

name: The Massachusetts Democratic Party
subject: Thank you, Mr. President.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
President Joe Biden will go down in history as one of the greatest leaders our nation has ever had. In the decades that he has spent in service to the American people, there has been no one more committed to decency, no one more fluent in compassion, no one more fervent in his dedication to each and every cause that might improve the lives of the people he represents.
It takes a man of great honor and breathtaking humility to commit his entire life to the service of others, and we are incredibly lucky to have a President who possesses perhaps the greatest trait of any leader; the willingness to relinquish a position of power and allow another to take his place.
The Biden Administration has been some of the most progressive years in our nation’s history. Joe Biden led us through a pandemic, codified same-sex marriage into law, championed student loan forgiveness, and passed a bipartisan infrastructure law that infused funds into countless communities. And he did it all with the same down-to-earth, empathetic style that caused the people of Delaware to elect him to the Senate back in 1972.
And now, by making the selfless choice to step aside, he has set the Democratic Party on a course for the future in which all of us, everywhere, are motivated not by preservation of the status quo, but by those bold, decisive, but necessary actions by which we change society for the better.
Joe Biden believes in a better world, in a world that views us all as equals and aims always to preserve our rights and freedom. Soon, there will be more to be said about the man he beat to take the White House, and the urgency of the work that must be done to ensure the poison he aims to spread across this country is resoundingly rejected. For now, though, our message is this: Thank you, President Biden.
The Massachusetts Democratic Party

Folks — This is an unprecedented moment in our nation’s history. President Biden has made the difficult decision to bow out of the 2024 race. Joe Biden is a decent man who loves this country. His sense of duty for America led him to this decision, and I have no doubt he will continue to serve the American people for years to come. Here’s what I need to say to you right now: Our main responsibility is to elect someone who is committed to democracy, justice, and a healthy, livable planet. Donald Trump has told us clearly that he wants a dictatorship from Day One, will do away with our environmental regulations and give free reign to Big Oil. We cannot allow that to happen and that means voting. Sitting it out or voting for a third party candidate means voting for fascism. The upcoming November election remains our most critical — and potentially our _last_ chance — to take decisive climate action to prevent the climate crisis from escalating to climate catastrophe. We cannot afford four years of damage done to our air, our water, and our health with Donald Trump and his Big Oil allies in the White House. We need a brave president who will lead us into a clean energy future and hold corporate polluters accountable for the harm they cause to our communities and our planet. But let me be clear: This isn't just about who sits in the White House. Bold climate policy is being set in state legislatures, city councils, and county boards all across the country. So much progress has been made. We mustn’t allow it to be undone. Every half degree of warming we can prevent will save millions of lives. Down-ballot races may not make national headlines, but they are hugely important and can act as a firewall, protecting us in the event of a worst-case scenario in November. Your support of my Climate PAC and our down-ballot races across the country is invaluable and strategic. So while we closely watch what happens at the top of the ticket, we are doubling our efforts to elect climate champions in 2024 and beyond. Hello,
Do you know what a “tracker” is? I had never heard the term until after I decided to first run for office against Lauren Boebert in 2022.
“Trackers” are essentially professional stalkers – the political version of paparazzi. They’re paid by Super PACs or groups funded by the Koch brothers to follow you around with a video camera everywhere you go. Often, they yell ridiculous questions and try to get you to say something that they can then edit up and spin into a fake scandal or put in attack ads.
Well, the first tracker of the campaign has begun showing up to my events with voters – recording every word I say and every breath I take.
This is going to be one of the closest and most important races on Election Night. In 2022, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes.
We can win this critical House seat, but the Super PACs are coming after me. They know how close this race is going to be – especially now that Lauren Boebert has run off scared.
**I’m not taking money from corporate PACs, so if we’re going to be able to fight back against their lies, I’m counting on you. We need to raise another $30,000 before our next fundraising deadline if we’re going to win this critical House seat, and right now, we’re still very short.**

clean_body: Do you know what a “tracker” is? Hello, Do you know what a “tracker” is? I had never heard the term until after I decided to first run for office against Lauren Boebert in 2022. “Trackers” are essentially professional stalkers – the political version of paparazzi. They’re paid by Super PACs or groups funded by the Koch brothers to follow you around with a video camera everywhere you go. Often, they yell ridiculous questions and try to get you to say something that they can then edit up and spin into a fake scandal or put in attack ads. Well, the first tracker of the campaign has begun showing up to my events with voters – recording every word I say and every breath I take. This is going to be one of the closest and most important races on Election Night. In 2022, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes. We can win this critical House seat, but the Super PACs are coming after me. They know how close this race is going to be – especially now that Lauren Boebert has run off scared. I’m not taking money from corporate PACs, so if we’re going to be able to fight back against their lies, I’m counting on you. name: Tim Holbert, American Veterans Center
subject: Hold the sand from Normandy Beach
body:
With every passing day, we lose more of these living legends. | | | [ ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=8b95ca6613204f16848fc3929916377a&_e=LhMAowZ6_eL0_X-uzOBrUGCjmW62-7upTDbp2PdEXTLoT41QRDdKeA7UKNuFvflqSZLOTzM9hV3b_qIxojNz3pVvc4Q4HsXOFsEfKvEDVywTeLdmP8qeYw9QuaDGcBQNpy-TZcrQbYo_cT332ZqFMQEClhVqjgXenOwsuKTl6eJjroue9CpNJRejwHYHL4H8zvxJpiLa0nsoVvuKRbBpmrweiqD_2EA7-eTNusB-GF-Fpc3m5yHpE9DkEtAY2Bjr_1HujMDFljWmpSPQiJ7HCTEqCUAjIlax3ClhtW86zSvVhO5VRn-0zZt39Gq1FUpK)
---
Peter, When they hit the beaches of Normandy at the start of D-Day, they changed the world – and saved our freedom. Peter, while thousands bravely served on D-Day, only a small number of those heroes, now all in their 90s and 100s, remain with us today. They’re the last living witnesses to the events that changed history, and they’re counting on _us_ to preserve their memory and legacy when they’re gone.
---
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=8b95ca6613204f16848fc3929916377a&_e=LhMAowZ6_eL0_X-uzOBrUGCjmW62-7upTDbp2PdEXTLoT41QRDdKeA7UKNuFvflqSZLOTzM9hV3b_qIxojNz3pVvc4Q4HsXOFsEfKvEDVywTeLdmP8qeYw9QuaDGcBQNpy-TZcrQbYo_cT332ZqFMQEClhVqjgXenOwsuKTl6eINUbbPTp4W39U4REF8YyUmgp8Y0nJ52S6c0-2FfAdGJc0cVX-AUmYTMfYDtuY17aTRVBEtWhhExlrTgqK-HxukB2aDKJcEmp6sADlHzDNGgUvkRIE-uAfr0emYO0f-sLET7wBjfDPF0rZKY366R7Xq)
---
**[Will you stand with the American Veterans Center to preserve and pass on these D-Day stories to the next generation? Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

| | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=a32ad30769484998b42d97a695b1a4d9&_t=RwKoXabSdFB9Buq1h9Lj01pm7dEA6R_Q7k3w5G8_hAljMklPaY3yLj-__AywAWs-aXqM0wA6B9L3_Enwp82XuouPfNcNcmkAsWbN78rBj5F179I6Ok3y8Q2Ed5fPwxOw)_

| | [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a32ad30769484998b42d97a695b1a4d9&_e=ut-0kcHt5OsBZkBKRwMLE7BXmZa0ygRbtJjDuY6uWTmNiDZ-SDXYbOolNvnFpKfsWRy1wP4rY7WRgCmiEeRvsdv1nhCIYQFU29I-e0etu3Bo10q_rqBf8BEr5exeGusaia7kQ1s2F1LlnE5BEUAvLWIZHtohqZCaQHr4StPPhhgFBXtrnOZbvp8c29qH8ad47iUjm-HvdnNtplUFgfH6rOr3ewA3kEjlAErBusku87Qlkqg6WRw8uDQPKuOaNOZJ7C0-F78K39ShNCClIPaPQoUL4Ib8aY-r2flFOINeqYR_uLwFvqqytjUwi9LrkP_YGLgCpBprR58_pWM8NpXpz9dvTvIIRb-R7dUd-5v3CMZG47DLXd0lLSjuza7FgA1wZsAM9UymJMfZBUD7D7GJSg%3D%3D)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a32ad30769484998b42d97a695b1a4d9&_e=ut-0kcHt5OsBZkBKRwMLE7BXmZa0ygRbtJjDuY6uWTmNiDZ-SDXYbOolNvnFpKfsWRy1wP4rY7WRgCmiEeRvsdv1nhCIYQFU29I-e0etu3Bo10q_rqBf8BEr5exeGusaia7kQ1s2F1LlnE5BEUAvLWIZHtohqZCaQHr4StPPhhgFBXtrnOZbvp8c29qH8ad47iUjm-HvdnNtplUFgfH6rOr3ewA3kEjlAErBusku87TfPi-pmB9u4JsSn45ShTH2zzzvWWvtyVC6CHxdiSNoXptCSzYQtcu7CtZoPTaZ55l1iellr5N6vV025a3snme0Ht4thJs3A-XkbRWSLQqIWOhlsAxjlYAhOj4dYEW5_MUFSWuNIp3rlrZBz0pWZXwijUoIrd3pXRdPfZiUAQ8zxA%3D%3D).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** --on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** --Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools--there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a32ad30769484998b42d97a695b1a4d9&_e=ut-0kcHt5OsBZkBKRwMLE7BXmZa0ygRbtJjDuY6uWTmNiDZ-SDXYbOolNvnFpKfsWRy1wP4rY7WRgCmiEeRvsdv1nhCIYQFU29I-e0etu3Bo10q_rqBf8BEr5exeGusaia7kQ1s2F1LlnE5BEUAvLWIZHtohqZCaQHr4StPPhhgFBXtrnOZbvp8c29qH8ad47iUjm-HvdnNtplUFgfH6rOr3ewA3kEjlAErBusku87RHCaj56BbB7JfCxbvEJa_GPv9vSo3slqvZ5hJeMM0KsrCLCq0oBthu83iu-ZhisCQWhhFJFawMqgQUst6YDM74bZo9G_bYQIlF1WEc3ZoGJ2OJkbWGt61bXGcJXWOZcp0MjXSrlDyxOxZivHEARAcSUYSHLjmKbZzNkQ5CoWDJ0w%3D%3D)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a32ad30769484998b42d97a695b1a4d9&_e=ut-0kcHt5OsBZkBKRwMLE7BXmZa0ygRbtJjDuY6uWTmNiDZ-SDXYbOolNvnFpKfsWRy1wP4rY7WRgCmiEeRvsdv1nhCIYQFU29I-e0etu3Bo10q_rqBf8BEr5exeGusaia7kQ1s2F1LlnE5BEUAvLWIZHtohqZCaQHr4StPPhhgFBXtrnOZbvp8c29qH8ad47iUjm-HvdnNtplUFgfH6rOr3ewA3kEjlAErBusku87R-QRIh-t0Pcm1Xi0Sv9eJueeM4dMQTkOV71f4huhSmjl7ybuwadNVeIYQngUDE3Uuz68d5JVOjUaAG1kfcrZzrX37Yzfei9bcsIGeYsU-VBVHSs6oNQyIsCXqjbUF33CP0Sw_sDvzBJ1sJQRAaWPO1QIX4g8l8AoXC11vLEEPATw%3D%3D)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.
---

body:
President Biden made the right choice for our country
| | |
---
Friend —

I’ll keep this short, but I wanted to reach out in light of today’s news. President Biden has made the decision to put our country first, and has withdrawn from the presidential election. I want to thank the president for his life of public service, and for honoring that legacy with his decision today.
Let’s be clear: Our country is at a crossroads, and the election in November could be the end of democracy as we know it. Rick Scott is one of the architects of the GOP’s catastrophic vision for America, and a Scott-led Senate is one of the greatest threats to progress. It has never been more important that we organize and work hard to reach every voter, tell them what’s at stake on November 5, and get them to the polls.

We must stand united against the attacks on our freedoms and democracy. This election will come down to whether we can unify as Americans to protect our values, freedoms, and opportunities of this incredible nation, or whether we allow extreme right-wing politicians to take control for power and self-enrichment.
Together, I am confident we can preserve American democracy and protect the American dream that I and so many others have lived — but that work starts today. Thank you for being in this fight with me, and thank you for believing in a brighter future for our state and for our country.

— Debbie

| | 10 years ago, then Vice President Biden pulled me aside in a hallway outside the Oval Office and said, "Andy, remember it's not that all politics is local, it's that all politics is personal." In his lifetime of service, President Biden has given our country everything he had. He worked so hard to improve our nation because it's personal for him. But he also connected with me and so many others because he cared about us. As a result, Biden will go down in history as a leader of consequence and a man who loved his country. President Biden has achieved so much – including passing the most significant legislation to fight climate change, saving our country and economy from the worst pandemic in our lifetimes, and making historic investments in infrastructure. Joe Biden's decision to lift up a new generation of leadership is extraordinary and one that cements his legacy. **Now, we must unify as a party and focus on our main goal for this November: defeating Donald Trump and his MAGA allies.** That's why I'm fully endorsing Vice President Kamala Harris to be our Democratic nominee for President. I have full faith in Vice President Harris to lead a new generation of leadership for our country and defeat Donald Trump. Her candidacy is historic, not just the opportunity to elect the first woman, the first AAPI President, and a Black woman, but to continue on the incredible progress we've started. **Thank you, President Biden, for all you've done for our country. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: What Joe Biden’s decision means for our country
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1675%2E135344%2ESRY_kG)

Friend --
As you have no doubt heard by now, President Biden has made the choice to suspend his presidential campaign.
Few public servants have given more to our country than Joe Biden. His record of accomplishment as a Senator, Vice President, and as President of the United States is unmatched. Over the last four years I’ve been proud to partner with his administration to take on Big Pharma, bring down the cost of prescription drugs, and to secure the biggest federal investment in Michigan’s infrastructure since the 1950s, to say nothing of delivering the biggest expansion of veterans healthcare benefits in decades.
I cannot imagine the difficulty of this decision, and he should be applauded not just for his accomplishments in office -- including leading our country through the COVID crisis -- but also for putting the future of this country and our democracy first. For that, we all owe him a debt of gratitude.
This is an unprecedented moment in our history, and I am sure that you, like so many Americans, are feeling a sense of uncertainty about what comes next. Which is why I wanted to take a moment to talk about what it means for our country -- and the November election.
First, one thing that hasn't changed: The November election will be an inflection point in our democracy where Americans will be faced with the choice of deciding what kind of country we want to be.
And we know Michigan will determine control of the White House and the Senate. Period. Full stop.
But when seismic shifts of this nature happen, they tend to generate an extraordinary amount of energy and action. So I am certain that as you read this, Republicans are emboldened in a way that will benefit our potential opponent.
Our job, today, while the presidential campaign is being sorted out is to make sure we don't pause and watch the world go by. We have to not only match their enthusiasm, but exceed it.
We have a big task ahead of us: Hold the White House, defend the Senate, and keep Michigan blue. But I cannot do that alone. For that, I need your help. So today -- especially today -- I am asking you to do something important that will help us win this Senate race:
[**Can I count on you to make today the day you contribute your first $3 contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate here in Michigan? I will put your donation right to work making sure Democrats in Michigan.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240721-3-900&t=2&akid=1675%2E135344%2ESRY_kG)

Friend, I’m not telling you this only in hopes that you’ll rush for your pocket book. I’m telling you this because I want you to know what type of man my husband is. This is Amy Brown and my husband Sam Brown is the Republican nominee for U.S. Senate in Nevada. I first met my husband in the burn unit when he returned from Afghanistan after a roadside bomb exploded under his vehicle. There was one thing about Sam that caught my attention immediately. It wasn’t the burns on his body, it wasn’t the scars on the face. His vibrant faith in God glowed brightly even in his darkest days. Everyone that encountered Sam could see it. For me, Sam was a light that guided me, challenged me, and reconnected me with God and the Church. I had grown up in the Church but had lost my Faith – I was at my rock bottom until I met Sam. During that time, I shared with him some of the struggles I had faced. He told me he was concerned for my Salvation – and for that matter so was I. **[That brought us to where we are today, 15 years later. We have 3 kids and I’m a Bible-believing momma who puts Bible lessons in our family's homeschool curriculum.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=3b829bbbd11249d29547f247b79b39b5&_e=pwO1JIacGXhyPNchYsxPiVhYPCsDLnU0LPKEi2tjHpupJZIHxR6KCDi8ItzG3xlcvGLBmkjL2oPL393rXsOVKbBuEtjRBBPN9HW0kNKS-ZVOzIpPP8u6wiaCNJvqnYtg7Ax6HWywQDxV9Z6QKWeN8sQPmRTpsUUelBofdH-nlfOgUTpkgrVuCIKGKqaEPS9_OBo9eD35nMJc8muSsO84VNdMs5QFT7k3QZNnkbHME_J488GmY581jfdZuyI7gH32Lsev3QQWNiVyrRHluppT22UXhSDXnhaU6Y-Hxy3c1xk6pQ3ZyaKqynFKRMgBjzUEJwM4VMQtLLEwKyyaaVLXm00XFGtpgDrxmfEQ9w9c3z6QgjPuXz4nzOjC46hlO8pgi0jqgxmq8KzxeE8qqFLzs1O9R1KV1gcDxZukCzrkSot_-c0hIrWJo5azCzRTpg6U1gtntawiyDBqvO_RRcdlWg%3D%3D)** Friend, if i hadn't gone through my darkest days, I may have never met Sam and never found a way back to God the way that I did. **[Everything Sam had planned to do with his life changed in 60 seconds in Afghanistan, but it never changed who he was.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=3b829bbbd11249d29547f247b79b39b5&_e=pwO1JIacGXhyPNchYsxPiVhYPCsDLnU0LPKEi2tjHpupJZIHxR6KCDi8ItzG3xlcvGLBmkjL2oPL393rXsOVKbBuEtjRBBPN9HW0kNKS-ZVOzIpPP8u6wiaCNJvqnYtg7Ax6HWywQDxV9Z6QKWeN8sQPmRTpsUUelBofdH-nlfOgUTpkgrVuCIKGKqaEPS9_OBo9eD35nMJc8muSsO84VNdMs5QFT7k3QZNnkbHME_J488GmY581jfdZuyI7gH32Lsev3QQWNiVyrRHluppT22UXhSDXnhaU6Y-Hxy3c1xk6pQ3ZyaKqynFKRMgBjzUEVYzqpWPFMHalcr4tEyJfCJv1S4qZTCC9Zh3Vp2Ladf7zhkwRVPjCcmL3SJXcl8E3EmZeNkgE0kEta4g91h0YpWhIx5NFvJJRTxyppRSHl_oU-hUVSg4bZQFoZInP_3-cy7c0XBfuFdrLSMsjKpR2mQ%3D%3D) ** His faith never wavered. ---
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE July 21, 2024**
Contact: Kait Ahern — communications@yda.org **

---
**YDA, CDA, AND HSDA HONORING PRESIDENT BIDEN'S LEGACY AS HE ENDS 2024 RE-ELECTION BID.
**
---
WASHINGTON, D.C. – Moments ago, President Joseph R. Biden announced he would be suspending his 2024 campaign and no longer seeking re-election. Today, we honor President Biden as a leader whose service to America has been nothing short of extraordinary. In 2020, he inherited a nation grappling with division and uncertainty– an America battling for the soul of its democracy. In 2024, he leaves it more unified and resilient, having successfully navigated us through an era of profound challenges into a time of remarkable progress. In the wake of an insurrection, his administration delivered lifesaving economic assistance to millions of people, businesses, and communities through the American Rescue Plan and Bipartisan Infrastructure Deal; brokered the largest investment in climate protection in history through the Inflation Reduction Act; signed student loan forgiveness, making higher education accessible and giving us a future without the weight of crushing debt; and appointed nearly 500 progressive judges to the federal court system who will fortify our democracy by defending racial, LGBTQ+, reproductive, and voting rights for decades to come. As we bid farewell to President Biden's candidacy in the 2024 election, we turn our gaze toward an exciting new chapter. The Young Democrats of America, College Democrats of America, and High School Democrats of America proudly stand behind whichever candidate is elected at the upcoming 2024 DNC Convention. As our future candidate is handed this torch of progress and leadership, we will be by their side to support them. We are ready to work towards a continuation of the fight for justice, equality, and opportunity that President Biden championed. Our opponents, led by Donald Trump and his running mate J.D. Vance, have a vision that stands in stark opposition to our values. Their agenda seeks to undermine the progress we’ve made—attempting to impose a federal ban on abortion, roll back decades of LGBTQ+ and racial rights, erode democratic institutions, and dismantle the administrative state– gutting agencies like the EPA and departments like the Department of Education. In this critical moment, the choice could not be clearer. We must rally behind our next Democratic nominee, together. As the party of progress, we are proud to embody the promise of a more just and inclusive America in the face of our opponent’s extremism. We have no doubt that our next nominee’s leadership will be pivotal as we confront the challenges ahead and safeguard the progress we’ve achieved. Democracy is not promised; it is a privilege we must keep alive. Thank you, President Biden, for your service, your leadership, and your legacy. And thank you, in advance, to our next Democratic nominee and future President for stepping forward to lead us into another era of progress. With collective determination and hope for tomorrow, we rise to the challenge together and build a future where every American can thrive.
---

| | **The stakes in this election are high and the choice is as clear as ever.** Democrats are delivering results for working families and upholding our shared values while the party of Trump is focused on undermining working families and dismantling the progress we have made as a nation. I am proud of the accomplishments we have achieved. We lowered healthcare costs for seniors and ensured the government can negotiate lower prescription costs for families. We passed the PACT Act to ensure healthcare for veterans that were exposed to toxic burn pits. During the longest stretch of low unemployment, we delivered 15.8 million jobs by passing the largest investment in repairing and building the next generation of roads, bridges and highways. And we are the only party fighting to restore reproductive freedom in this country. **We are not done working for you. As a party, we will continue to deliver results that count for your family and your pocketbook.** I laud President Biden's vision and leadership. With him in the White House, our agenda became a reality for the American people. I believe that we can build on these accomplishments and continue to deliver results that matter. We must continue to create an economy that works for everyone and understand that everyday Americans are struggling to make ends meet. We must protect reproductive freedom and continue to lower healthcare costs. And we must protect our democracy, our environment and our voting rights. All of this is possible when we elect the Democratic ticket – from the White House to retaking the House majority and maintaining the majority in the Senate. **With your help and your vote, together we can build on these victories and deliver for the American people.** _Rick_ |

clean_body: | | | | The stakes in this election are high and the choice is as clear as ever. Democrats are delivering results for working families and upholding our shared values while the party of Trump is focused on undermining working families and dismantling the progress we have made as a nation. I am proud of the accomplishments we have achieved. We lowered healthcare costs for seniors and ensured the government can negotiate lower prescription costs for families. We passed the PACT Act to ensure healthcare for veterans that were exposed to toxic burn pits. During the longest stretch of low unemployment, we delivered 15.8 million jobs by passing the largest investment in repairing and building the next generation of roads, bridges and highways. And we are the only party fighting to restore reproductive freedom in this country. We are not done working for you. As a party, we will continue to deliver results that count for your family and your pocketbook. I laud President Biden's vision and leadership. With him in the White House, our agenda became a reality for the American people. I believe that we can build on these accomplishments and continue to deliver results that matter. We must continue to create an economy that works for everyone and understand that everyday Americans are struggling to make ends meet. We must protect reproductive freedom and continue to lower healthcare costs. And we must protect our democracy, our environment and our voting rights. All of this is possible when we elect the Democratic ticket – from the White House to retaking the House majority and maintaining the majority in the Senate. With your help and your vote, together we can build on these victories and deliver for the American people. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Our fight to elect Kamala Harris begins today
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240721-4127-footer&t=1001&akid=4127%2E420207%2EyB6Xcc ]Pramila Jayapal

Peter, I am sure
you have seen the news and I wanted to make sure I shared my thoughts with
you.

President Joe Biden has been the most progressive and effective President
on domestic and economic policy in my lifetime. It has been an incredible
honor to work alongside him to pass truly historic legislation that has
lifted up working and poor people across the country and fundamentally
changed the nature of government so that it works for people not for the
wealthiest billionaires and largest corporations. President Biden has
never forgotten where he came from or what it means for people to know
that he has their backs.

His leadership has been unparalleled, with the results crystal clear with
the record of achievements: the lowest unemployment in over 50 years; the
biggest investment in taking on climate change in history; an historic
investment in rebuilding our nation’s infrastructure with union and green
jobs; taking on Big Pharma to reduce the cost of prescription drugs; being
the most pro-union president in history and fostering the tremendous
energy of workers organizing across the country; the clear focus on
investing in communities that have been disproportionately affected by
structural racism and economic inequities; serving as the most pro-union
president in history and enabling the largest movement of worker
organizing in recent history; and historic appointments to key positions
including the first Black woman Supreme Court Justice and his historic
appointment of Kamala Harris as his Vice President, partner and nation’s
leader on abortion rights, among many other issues. I am forever grateful
to President Biden for saving our country from COVID and a Donald Trump
presidency, and for the tremendous legacy of service he has given to our
country.

I know President Biden’s decision to step aside this election comes after
careful and deliberative consideration of the best path forward to win the
House, Senate, and White House, and protect our democracy — which has
always remained his top priority. I respect his decision and I applaud his
full-throated endorsement of Vice President Harris to be our Democratic
nominee who will continue President Biden’s legacy, defeat Donald Trump,
win the House and the Senate and defend our rights and freedoms.

Millions of Americans cast their ballots for Joe Biden and Kamala Harris
in the primary. Vice President Harris has proven time and time again that
she can prosecute the case against Donald Trump and campaign vigorously
for Democrats down the ballot. She will mobilize and energize our base to
re-engage and ensure that we turn out every single voter across the
country and deliver victory in November. She has been a partner to
President Biden in pushing the Biden-Harris Administration’s achievements,
and she has embraced the Biden-Harris 100-day agenda that will energize
the country toward a vision of what we must and will implement when we
keep the White House and Senate and take back the House: restoring Roe v.
Wade, signing the John Lewis Voting Rights Act, capping rent increases to
5 percent, expanding Social Security and Medicare, ending all medical
debt, raising the minimum wage, passing the PRO Act, and more.

At a time when Donald Trump and his Republican Party have stripped away
women’s reproductive freedoms, we will respond by finally electing the
first woman to the presidency. And as the first South Asian woman elected
to the House of Representatives, I look forward to seeing Kamala Harris
become the first South Asian American and first Black woman to serve as
the President of the United States of America. Democrats must immediately
unite so we can focus on winning in November. I look forward to casting my
vote for Kamala Harris for President and doing everything I can to ensure
she becomes our next President.

Together,

Pramila

Friends, family, and supporters:
As I have been saying for weeks, President Biden is a patriotic American who has always put the needs of our country ahead of himself.
For more than five decades, he has served this country admirably as a Senator, Vice President, and now President. His decision today reflects the same patriotism that George Washington and Teddy Roosevelt demonstrated when they selflessly put their country above their own political ambitions.
From ushering in an economic recovery from the pandemic that is the envy of the world, to finally rebuilding our roads and bridges, reclaiming our leadership on the international stage, lowering the cost of prescription drugs, and capping the cost of insulin, President Biden has achieved historic progress for our country.
I’m deeply grateful for his years of service.
I am laser-focused on building on the historic accomplishments of the Biden-Harris Administration by continuing to lower costs for Virginians, protecting our democracy at home and abroad, and safeguarding Americans’ reproductive freedoms.
I’m looking forward to working with my friend Kamala Harris and a great ticket mate to keep Virginia blue so that we can continue to build on our progress.
-Tim Kaine

clean_body: We need to know where you stand in this moment. | | | Peter — in case you haven't seen the breaking news: President Joe Biden has officially announced his decision to withdraw from the 2024 presidential race, and is endorsing Vice President Kamala Harris to be the Democratic Party's nominee for president in November. He’s made an honorable decision to pass the torch to the next generation of leadership — and we thank him for it. In just four years in office, President Biden passed the Inflation Reduction Act through a nearly deadlocked Congress, made history by joining UAW auto workers on the picket line, and guided the country out of a global pandemic and turbulent economic waters. The next Democratic President has the opportunity to build on these achievements, Peter. And we know — from talking to tens of thousands of you over the last few months — that you are ready to get to work to defeat Trump and MAGA in November. But first, we need to know where you are and what you are feeling in this moment. Can you take our rapid response WFP member poll now? Over the coming days, we plan to engage in a careful endorsement process with members like you, our state chapters, and our affiliates. But what you’ve already made clear to us is this: Donald Trump cannot be allowed to win this election. Trump and his MAGA friends have created a 900-page plan called “Project 2025” that says exactly what they will do if they win power. They want to destroy public education, ban abortion nationwide, and make it even harder for workers to organize for better wages. The contrast with our vision for America couldn’t be clearer. We’re going to organize this year and in the coming years to tackle climate change, restore abortion rights, and build an economy that puts working people first. The stakes this November for all the issues we care about are sky-high. And we believe that if we come together over the next 106 days, we will win. In solidarity, Maurice Mitchell National Director Working Families Party Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. name: David Hogg
subject: BREAKING: Biden is leaving the race
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
This is a pivotal moment for our country and the Democratic Party.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240721&t=1&akid=968%2E587540%2EGCnOg-)
Peter,
**President Biden is no longer the Democratic nominee.**
This is a pivotal moment for our country and the Democratic Party.
I want to share my thoughts with you, but first I want to take a moment to thank President Biden for everything that he has done for our country during his long record of public service.
From passing the largest investment in fighting climate change in our nation’s history to pushing for student debt cancellation, significant gun reform, and more – I can honestly say that his presidency has been one of record achievement and historic success. As he leaves the race, I hope he is as proud as I am of everything that he has accomplished over the past four years for the American people.
Today, I am thankful that President Biden is doing what he thinks is best for the country and the fight for our democracy by passing the torch to a new generation of Democratic leadership. **We’re ready to support the new Democratic ticket – along with the young progressive leaders we’re electing all across the country this year.**
**[Can you make a contribution now to support Leaders We Deserve? The work we are doing is building the foundation for the future of our party and nation.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240721?refcode=em20240721&amount=5&refcode2=968_587540_GCnOg-&akid=968%2E587540%2EGCnOg-)**
President Biden reminds us of the power of starting in politics so young. Elected to the Senate at just 29 years old, he gained over 50 years experience which helped make him one of the most successful presidents in modern American history.
He understands that power too. Just a week after the launch of Leaders We Deserve, he called me directly to tell me how excited he was about this movement. _(It’s a crazy story — I was in the airport when he called and I was shaking so hard when he was giving me his assistant’s phone number to set up a future meeting, he had to repeat the phone number to me four times because I couldn’t write it down correctly haha)_
**State by state and race by race, we’re building a bench of young leaders who WILL be the future of the Democratic Party.** Just like Joe Biden was 50 years ago. In fact, I bet that one of our candidates will be President someday.
Because of your support, we elected Molly Cook to the Texas State House supporting her campaign with over $300,000 spent, she won by just 64 votes, and now she’s a rising star in the Democratic Party. We are going to elect even more young leaders this November with your support.
_It has never been more important_ to invest in down-ballot Democrats who can hold the line and build the future that we deserve, where we elect leaders who truly represent us and who will live to see the effects of their policy choices.
**[In this historic moment, it’s absolutely critical that we rally behind the next generation of leadership. Will you rush in a $5 contribution to help Leaders We Deserve elect progressive young candidates and build our bench?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240721?refcode=em20240721&amount=5&refcode2=968_587540_GCnOg-&akid=968%2E587540%2EGCnOg-)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240721?amount=5&refcode=em20240721-968&refcode2=968_587540_GCnOg-&akid=968%2E587540%2EGCnOg-)**
Now is the time to step up and chip in. How we respond to this moment is incredibly important. We hope you’ll join us.
— David Hogg
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-footer?refcode=em20240721&t=2&refcode2=968_587540_GCnOg-&akid=968%2E587540%2EGCnOg-)**

His historic record has brought transformational investments in infrastructure, climate action, gun violence prevention, all while tackling inflation and fighting on behalf of working people. President Biden has once again shown us what it looks like to lead with integrity and love of country. The President understands that the White House must continue to be occupied by someone who believes in democracy, the constitution and protecting civil rights. And the alternative is a demagogue who only cares about one thing: himself. If elected, Donald Trump would be emboldened to test the limits of our democracy in service of his own dangerous impulses. The future of our democracy hangs in the balance. Vice President Kamala Harris has been an exceptional partner in the battle for dignity for working families, for reproductive freedoms and fighting corporate greed. Through her leadership, we will be able to build on the President’s legacy and get the job done. President Biden is the most progressive and effective President of our lifetime, and he has my immense gratitude and respect. Today, President Biden cemented his legacy as a true patriot and a man of deep integrity. Now it’s time for all of us to get to work and secure Kamala Harris in the White House. Sincerely, Becca Balint

Team Rosen,

President Joe Biden just announced that he is no longer seeking reelection.
**This is an unprecedented moment in an election cycle – and it will have profound effects for our country and on the Senate race here in Nevada. **What we do next is going to determine who wins the White House and the Senate in November, plain and simple.
[**(This is a longer message, but if you are already with me, can you make a $5 donation to my campaign _right now_ so we can protect our Democratic Senate majority? I wouldn’t ask if it wasn’t critically important.)**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89298283/486828556/1399925512?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk4227-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNWVlN2E2Ny1hMTQ3LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8xeSu4d6yUpB8kJ6bps-bGlv64IF1OS_8nug6Peoa1A=)

**_We absolutely cannot let that happen._**
Another four years of Trump in the White House with a Republican Senate majority would be catastrophic to everything we believe in and fight for. Defending our Senate majority is the ONLY way we can safeguard our most fundamental rights and freedoms – no matter what happens at the top of the ticket.
Political experts predict that Nevada will determine control of the Senate AND the White House, which means everything from abortion rights to our very democracy is on the line in the Silver State.** ****_The Cook Political Report_ recently downgraded Nevada from “Toss-Up” to “Lean R,” so we have our work cut out for us. **
Our path forward will not be easy, but I know that we can come together and win in November. **We must stay diligent and work harder than ever before****–****because more is at stake than ever before.**
**I cannot predict what the next few months until Election Day have in store, but I do know that this moment will define what happens in November. | _Battleground tested and voter approved, Elizabeth LIZ Johnson is our Georgia 12th district choice to serve as The People’s Representative in The People’s House _ _in DC. _

# **_An important message from Liz Johnson_**

CHALLENGING TIMES REQUIRE BOLD STEPS

YES we're all experiencing some pretty challenging moments right now.

However, if you've ever overcome any form of emotional, financial, and/or physical unexpected disruptions, then you already know that troubling times don’t always last. This time is no different.

Let’s remember the reasons why we’re continuously on the battlefield for the victories we seek both collectively and individually!

1. _The status quo isn’t working for us._
2. _People still can’t pay their bills and basics like food and housing are a struggle to maintain._
3. _The most vulnerable in our community aren’t being protected._
4. _The American Dream has become unattainable for far too many._

**_It’s more important than ever to stay the course and unite to make these priorities, realities._**

_96 women across the country are running as democrats to challenge Republican incumbents in this November 5th election. Elizabeth LIZ Johnson in Georgia 12 is boldly running, for the third time, to unseat Republican incumbent Rick Allen._

# _We can do this, I know we can! _

My fellow Americans, Over the past three and a half years, we have made great progress as a nation. Today, America has the strongest economy in the world. We've made historic investments in rebuilding our nation, in lowering prescription drug costs for seniors, and in expanding affordable health care to a record number of Americans. We've provided critically needed care to a million veterans exposed to toxic substances. Passed the first gun safety law in 30 years. Appointed the first African American woman to the Supreme Court. And passed the most significant climate legislation in the history of the world. America has never been better positioned to lead than we are today. I know none of this could have been done without you, the American people. Together, we overcame a once in a century pandemic and the worst economic crisis since the Great Depression. We've protected and preserved our democracy. And we've revitalized and strengthened our alliances around the world. It has been the greatest honor of my life to serve as your President. And while it has been my intention to seek reelection, I believe it is in the best interest of my party and the country for me to stand down and to focus solely on fulfilling my duties as President for the remainder of my term. For my part: my very first decision as the party nominee in 2020 was to pick Kamala Harris as my Vice President. And it’s been the best decision I’ve made. **Today I want to offer my full support and endorsement for Kamala to be the nominee of our party this year. Democrats — it’s time to come together and beat Trump.[And if you’re with us, donate to her campaign here:](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.NV3IV8RXB3BPG-RgoenRivizIuY7_hyRTlr0Ev1A4jwo48Pzlh6he5y-OY0IheoZ_YOlNzXMIbk-OfOLUWxfjXL03cts-1q7dqF2gLnE3LbYHt_JtI6EHSOn1G4Mndgu_DkbYUQH71PovBZ3WPudKiV7ezSNxZE3GcIECNMtronHeJYMWt0t5ilQRzFUlgikHDvBt4gE6RoYakMNZEcMHoR3RfEUXEhVsqSsHfzujyPhEygZTWNNal7yIZl1MGMG-URnmMY8xYINgGmD3QTil8b2uZohDQKoVeJ8vyUdahpl3Tflrm44lbCS8u3FzGdc4ImQdK3wMnDrwHZObdqOCCxlaJXQIMPV2di05oNLlsMSg5Yf_MzRcxIgWnjd8dRZcujsJaunwdEj4SIe2pLZaCkQJqX_3OpG8LLlQ1HdXwjVnZnifCMTNW9xfgPx0YXeTiyJ4juCWoVa1MWBI2uD-a4xUHi2K0K0hYd0j05GfZc7EIQW3wtoUMLkaUfpto0xiS5K8BR3oLPVj-D1eG2BXTikr9OSjD5XtJxevzDvnYZtZUGTZo8_ysMALsUi6SxHfDchjEYBcvRdFvyZ6qT_HTzkmmDUlcShWm4co4B2PF4/488/i6wMVzRJTdC1txh9i2NFJw/h0/h001.3dwrisx3ProM4vBJqJj8POzrl57LLos3XfL30feugk8)** | If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

clean_body: | | | My fellow Americans, Over the past three and a half years, we have made great progress as a nation. Today, America has the strongest economy in the world. We've made historic investments in rebuilding our nation, in lowering prescription drug costs for seniors, and in expanding affordable health care to a record number of Americans. We've provided critically needed care to a million veterans exposed to toxic substances. Passed the first gun safety law in 30 years. Appointed the first African American woman to the Supreme Court. And passed the most significant climate legislation in the history of the world. America has never been better positioned to lead than we are today. I know none of this could have been done without you, the American people. Together, we overcame a once in a century pandemic and the worst economic crisis since the Great Depression. We've protected and preserved our democracy. And we've revitalized and strengthened our alliances around the world. It has been the greatest honor of my life to serve as your President. And while it has been my intention to seek reelection, I believe it is in the best interest of my party and the country for me to stand down and to focus solely on fulfilling my duties as President for the remainder of my term. For my part: my very first decision as the party nominee in 2020 was to pick Kamala Harris as my Vice President. And it’s been the best decision I’ve made. Today I want to offer my full support and endorsement for Kamala to be the nominee of our party this year. Democrats — it’s time to come together and beat Trump. | If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | ** I am grateful to every member of this team for the work they’ve done and will continue to do to save our democracy. [1]Justice Democrats

Breaking news, Peter:

President Biden just announced he is no longer running for a second term
and is dropping out of the November presidential race. We, of course,
welcome this decision and commend the President for doing what is best
both for the Democratic Party and our country as a whole.

That being said, President Biden and Party leadership should have never
let it get this far. We are on the brink of fascism once again, and the
stakes could not be higher. Democratic Party leadership and the
establishment have routinely shown us they would rather risk it all than
let the next generation lead.

Our mission at Justice Democrats has always been to recruit and elect the
next generation of diverse, working-class leaders to Congress who are
gonna fight like hell for all of us and do politics differently. That
mission has never been more important than in this moment.

The Squad in Congress — leaders like Jamaal Bowman, Cori Bush, Summer Lee,
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Rashida Tlaib, and others — have been beacons of
hope and light in Congress.

Over the last 5 years, alongside other progressives in Congress, they have
shifted our expectations of how hard an elected leader can and should
fight for all of us. They have popularized and energized a base of
organized voters and volunteers who are ready to fight for worker’s
rights, Medicare for All, getting big money out of politics, a Green New
Deal, opposing genocide, and ending forever wars. And these are the people
that we need to put in the work and show up in November in order to defeat
Trump and deliver a Democratic victory.

We will continue to do our part alongside the Squad to organize our base
of voters and volunteers ahead of November to fight back against
right-wing extremism. Now, our country needs Party leadership to do the
same. It’s not just the White House at stake, but control of the House and
Senate too.

Regardless of what happens — we will continue to invest in the next
generation of voters and leaders who are ready to fight back. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240721-2.efsvUR&refcode=em20240721-35796&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=35796%2E1203867%2ENCRqtY ]If you’re

As Commissioner of Public Lands, I witnessed the impact of Biden’s Bipartisan Infrastructure Law firsthand. This historic legislation has made significant investments in our infrastructure to rebuild our roads and bridges, protect working forest and agricultural lands, restore critical salmon habitat, invest in our schools, invest in our coastal communities to reduce tsunami risk, and lower prescription drug costs. Now more than ever, we must work to keep the White House and our district blue by electing proven leaders who will get things done despite this highly partisan environment. As Commissioner of Public Lands, I’ve led by putting politics aside to deliver real results — making Washington a national leader in wildfire response, building affordable housing on state-owned lands for the first time ever, and creating good-paying jobs. name: Gabby Giffords
subject: A thank you to my friend, Joe Biden
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Friends -
Today, my good friend President Joe Biden announced his decision to no longer run for reelection.
We all owe President Joe Biden a debt of gratitude for his steady leadership when our country needed it most. In three and a half short years, he ended a pandemic, rescued the economy, fought climate change, and passed the most consequential gun violence prevention bill in decades. And through it all, he maintained his trademark decency, optimism, and empathy.
I will be forever grateful to President Biden for his compassion and personal friendship to me as I was recovering. He held my hand and gave me his 'word as a Biden' that he and Jill would always be there for me—and they were. He was by my side when I returned to cast my first vote following the shooting, and I was proud to stand by his side throughout his presidency, where he did more to fight gun violence than any president in history. His accomplishments will save lives for years to come. I am proud of my friend.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240721-2-30&t=1&akid=8544%2E3935704%2EMkR1GK)
Shortly after President Biden made his announcement, he endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to be the new Democratic presidential nominee.
I have known Kamala Harris for many years, and I can think of no better candidate who is ready to finish the job and end gun violence in our nation. It’s a job she has already started as our vice president. Without Vice President Harris, we could never have gotten the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ passed in 2022. She worked with President Biden to establish the first-ever federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention in 2023, which she now oversees.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240721-2-30&t=2&akid=8544%2E3935704%2EMkR1GK)
Vice President Harris’ strong and caring leadership will provide a steady hand to build upon this administration’s ceaseless work to save lives from gun violence. She will make a great president and will continue to be an influential partner for our movement.
But I need your help. GIFFORDS PAC can’t have the resources to help elect Kamala Harris without people like you chipping in to emails like these.
[**So please, can I ask you to make a donation of $5, $10, or anything you can afford today? We must all work together to ensure Vice President Harris wins this November.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240721-2-30&t=3&akid=8544%2E3935704%2EMkR1GK)
