name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: My response to President Biden’s announcement
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2277%2E4032634%2ETerBwD)
---
Joe Biden’s presidency has been transformational. He accomplished more in the past four years — to bring back jobs, stand up to big corporations, and build an economy that works for all of us — than we have been able to get done in the last forty. Leading us through a once-in-a-century pandemic. Getting vaccines in arms. Passing a historic economic rescue package. Creating over 15 million jobs. Ending the forever war in Afghanistan. Delivering a historic Bipartisan Infrastructure Law that’s putting Americans to work rebuilding roads and bridges and jump-starting clean energy projects. Dramatically increasing our nation’s investment in scientific research. Naming the first Black woman and first former federal public defender to the Supreme Court. Getting over 200 other judges onto the federal bench, including a record number of former public defenders on federal appeals courts. Bringing our allies together in defense of Ukraine and in defense of democracy around the world. Signing the first new federal gun safety legislation in decades. Capping the cost of insulin at $35 a month for seniors and spurring big drugmakers to apply that same cap for all their customers. Finally allowing Medicare to negotiate the price of prescription drugs. Capping out-of-pocket drug expenses for seniors. Securing our nation’s biggest-ever investment in fighting climate change. Bringing the rate of Americans without health insurance to historic lows. Putting a new tax on massively profitable corporations that had been getting away with paying $0 in federal income taxes. Cracking down on wealthy tax cheats. Kicking off a free tax filing program. Slashing junk fees. Finally scrutinizing corporate concentration after decades of the federal government allowing monopolies to get bigger and more powerful. Enshrining marriage equality as the law of the land to defend it from the radicals on the Supreme Court. Canceling student debt for nearly 5 million Americans. I am deeply grateful for his service, for the change he has made for working families, and for the way he’s led on the world stage — with wisdom and a steady hand. He deserves full credit for beating Donald Trump in 2020, and his selfless decision today gives us our best shot at doing it again in 2024. While Donald Trump tried to tear down our democracy to maintain his grip on power, Joe Biden willingly stepped aside in order to protect our democracy. President Biden’s selfless action is a profound gift to the people of the United States — and it’s on all of us not to waste it. I endorse Kamala Harris for President. She is a proven fighter who has been a national leader in safeguarding consumers and protecting access to abortion. As a former prosecutor, she can press a forceful case against allowing Donald Trump to regain the White House. We have many talented people in our party, but Vice President Harris is the person who was chosen by the voters to succeed Joe Biden if needed. She can unite our party, take on Donald Trump, and win in November. And next January, when she raises her right hand to take the presidential oath of office, millions of women and girls who see themselves in her will begin to dream bigger. Even with a new name on the top of the ticket, fundamental aspects of this race will not change. We’re still fighting for abortion rights, our democracy, an economy that works for working people, bedrock government promises like Social Security and Medicare, gun safety, LGBTQ+ equality, climate action — we know what we will be voting for in November And we know we are still pushing back against the same extremist forces of greed, hate, and division. We are still pushing back against the radical agenda of Project 2025. We are still pushing back against a Republican Party that denied the results of the 2020 election they lost, and leaders who fanned the flames of an insurrection to try to overturn those results. That’s who we’re up against. That’s who we must defeat at the ballot box. Now, I get it: with so much on the line in this election, it’s hard to process everything that’s going on. It’s easy to feel overwhelmed. We’ve been living through years of world-historic events. But at moments like these, we make each other stronger. I’m right here with you. And if we link arms, if we stay in the fight, we will win. We won’t just defeat Donald Trump again — like we did in 2020 when the American people turned out in record numbers and elected Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. We will build an America that works for everyone. I wanted to share these thoughts with you — and I want to thank you for being a part of this team. Elizabeth

| Hi friend -
---
We are 107 days away from November 5th, and worlds away from where we were eight short days ago.
From last Saturday’s failed assassination attempt and iconic rebound of President Trump, to, just a few hours ago, in an unprecedented move, President Biden’s announcement that he’s stepped down as the Democrat’s nominee for President.
What’s next? Well ... buckle up. _I won’t lay it all out here, but based on what we’re hearing we have every reason to believe the twists and turns have only just begun._
From now until November (and likely for some period of time thereafter) election integrity will be critical. Here’s what’s happening now, and some of what’s to come, at True the Vote:
* **SCAN. CHECK. PROTECT.** \- Over 20,000 people have used [SCP](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6VDKmqL7dnq-Z_xN8QkhdZKgsxsq4umEAocVLBID6l-zNtT8Cdg3GPakOs5Hew5FuYwKbxgNdhoBvt_chMlwvSKCxEaOX0ckgpTb-r1rCfsZ5eOTo2j02Qxe371bqhzfqMCFqhDe6nOfrJUrBrEDQ_8q6bLOFDjgiB4abTaLVa95TLUjMGkCsRlFWFOMSiJxLAD49FXqkDi_G0pL6y87YSxYYYjRZzeT91Xfz9oXvsgw/488/lSp0ED7SSRyI5ZO9QhsQ7A/h5/h001.9hoNrTkoIlWG7VTC30AeyGY3WNOzLS46kOMwMfCKMyA) to register to vote, check their registration, and remove old records. This is a great way to encourage engagement with family and friends!
* **CLEANING VOTER ROLLS** \- We are a few weeks away from the August 8th deadline to challenge ineligible voter registration records. Our platform,[ IV3](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.ZOvxkEhKDw9DETb6Ummm9zQuo-zt7v1AcpXkOLMbvNt6YrZM562R3uGahNjwIn7jkGt_IWnw-uSgtquK_mdpjjdISa-tLImUGCjFLnGJ8wjijXDH6YidiWlZcDVui39JHipqR3Aboh5crgmZ4J_3a2XLYyqLgUm93EUW_1U5r8dvNluZQE7CD1e4lk2JvpDrv1egCil7TCR9RdhtqIOYdA/488/lSp0ED7SSRyI5ZO9QhsQ7A/h6/h001.xoF9be4dGMgwRwTuajur5jWFPhj8mFRlWmE9qjArLUQ), has been used to great effect by over 35,000 volunteers. **To date, 6,937 citizens have completed 645,610 challenges across 1,322 counties.**
* **LAUNCHING NEW ELECTION SUPPORT APP -** Our new app, VoteAlert, is being tested right now and readied for launch in the next few weeks. This app will support realtime online reporting of election incidents and a bilingual toll free call line.
* **TRAINING, TRAINING, TRAINING** \- Teambuilding, Logic and Accuracy Participation, Long Term Care and College Outreach, Election Workers, Ballot Signature Verification ... [and more](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6XnSdcrSmzbZQfStcjy751h33LGvJJftPSdMKdku-K2a5Q8no-LfMvDuFEjMl34DgsOoTnrsg7eqrhk3VqaB5GC0ZBDuuwIqf9ijWIhvnZ9AkS6knfzn12nOtyYASiCO36R5gwCWGYx-Rs6DDX4Tmzz44Tds-8AOxzJk-KhfpnkMIhQ1lU9vpzEB_ARs8zzKSGiRiTy3qJySO8UpxmEt0zobE96XN5fbr1sSnwOwJTMC/488/lSp0ED7SSRyI5ZO9QhsQ7A/h7/h001.Vdc11ESEs3ig4uPWj2pNCF-AEMeukdPgs7VEtLoCn7g) ... we’re hosting Q&A; webinars 3x a week and focused trainings throughout the month.
* **BUILDING QUICK REFERENCE GUIDES FOR ELECTION WORKERS** \- Over our nearly 15 years, we’ve learned that when you are working in the field, you need ready access to key intel, contacts, and specific election codes. Every state is different. We’re working with volunteers around the clock to complete these materials and begin distribution.
* **PLANNING FOR EYES ON BALLOT DROPBOXES** \- From working with sheriffs to install and monitor dropboxes, to working with citizens to lawfully get eyes on, plans are underway to do all we can minimize the kind of exploitation we saw at ballot dropboxes in 2020.
* **RECRUITMENT OF BILINGUAL POLL WORKERS -** True the Vote has been steadily reaching out to the Latino community to encourage participation. Check out [Voto Honesto,](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6UlhyHm_y7hn9DgzM_XLbg-uJuLQLkUwwj21fPKqB9uvp_QC_BQQq3O79Hyd6RQTCvWVNnVBLAGbDideQwIPcvh3wmAX0wY8eTf7fXkVlubZd5VFndy317KxvrHx2IQEG8gRuxaaFw8b0RHjRGp83j2iDvIzvi_nJefes40HH-4GBPkUFrtvHFdjvZr4OgHXS7LflNSZp9_0f5qro6Xw0Io/488/lSp0ED7SSRyI5ZO9QhsQ7A/h8/h001.8c6DBnDc5JC3qWeQnak0MwvCTiLbUzOVB2zfdSXNElM) it’s True the Vote, but in Spanish.
* And of course, we are still collaborating with other pro-liberty groups and fighting on many fronts in court, as lawsuits will continue and likely more in store. [**PLEASE HELP US IF YOU CAN. WE NEED FINANCIAL SUPPORT NOW MORE THAN EVER.**](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6UAj3E_p8cNGXIOwo9MdaP4uURHu2CF_xBMsTaXvArHujZCYcWDflXvAHZOdWogeY67YYVzOuRaIaHqb0EQF0i6ti96rrq3S5noXyuTduKaOxKvB6PUKsMP2wINsW1TX5VqgUnen-Ryj-yzoEL7rP6VDfkW3o5Kv0GMTHHG9V7nnXTFiQP9tXdDYH2bK0CHNXtwtV4-d-g9CVLp8XjdpmrY/488/lSp0ED7SSRyI5ZO9QhsQ7A/h9/h001.fVZHkoxBmAop8eqL4llaP0Pnzj5edu-v6LgPE0BbA3M)**WE KNOW THIS LINK IS BEING BLOCKED BY SEVERAL BROWSERS. IF NECESSARY, YOU CAN TYPE IT IN AT**[**https://truethevote.org/donate**](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6UAj3E_p8cNGXIOwo9MdaP4uURHu2CF_xBMsTaXvArHujZCYcWDflXvAHZOdWogeY67YYVzOuRaIaHqb0EQF0i6ti96rrq3S5noXyuTduKaOxKvB6PUKsMP2wINsW1TX5VqgUnen-Ryj-yzoEL7rP6VDfkW3o5Kv0GMTHHG9V7nnXTFiQP9tXdDYH2bK0CHNXtwtV4-d-g9CVLp8XjdpmrY/488/lSp0ED7SSRyI5ZO9QhsQ7A/h10/h001.6Qo2TB8p9F1hTlnp6WHX3DiRIu7pwEB_J3pS0rwXKhI)

Many of the plans we have require significant investments in equipment, data, and tech support. What’s our budget? We will immediately deploy every donation. If we can raise $5,000,000, we will scale up and deploy. If we can only raise $500,000 we will scale down and deploy. It’s nearly impossible to know how to forecast. There are so many competing interests, and everything is happening at breakneck speed. But we are ready. We will spin straw to gold. We will stretch every dollar, and be assured, we are working nonstop.
We are all in. We will leave nothing on the field.
**[PLEASE HELP US IF YOU CAN. WE NEED FINANCIAL SUPPORT NOW MORE THAN EVER.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6UAj3E_p8cNGXIOwo9MdaP4uURHu2CF_xBMsTaXvArHujZCYcWDflXvAHZOdWogeY67YYVzOuRaIaHqb0EQF0i6ti96rrq3S5noXyuTduKaOxKvB6PUKsMP2wINsW1TX5VqgUnen-Ryj-yzoEL7rP6VDfkW3o5Kv0GMTHHG9V7nnXTFiQP9tXdDYH2bK0CHNXtwtV4-d-g9CVLp8XjdpmrY/488/lSp0ED7SSRyI5ZO9QhsQ7A/h11/h001.JjS78w48FO5oLeFAlW0ZA-jOYxujIicwUD2g8_MN6CM)******[**https://truethevote.org/donate**](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6UAj3E_p8cNGXIOwo9MdaP4uURHu2CF_xBMsTaXvArHujZCYcWDflXvAHZOdWogeY67YYVzOuRaIaHqb0EQF0i6ti96rrq3S5noXyuTduKaOxKvB6PUKsMP2wINsW1TX5VqgUnen-Ryj-yzoEL7rP6VDfkW3o5Kv0GMTHHG9V7nnXTFiQP9tXdDYH2bK0CHNXtwtV4-d-g9CVLp8XjdpmrY/488/lSp0ED7SSRyI5ZO9QhsQ7A/h12/h001.z_ceaEObIsx5Ed4i_a1RtPRF4cH7tS5SlWVEjnPmMHc)
Hundreds of millions will be raised by candidates and PACs for online messaging and flurries of lawsuits. But THERE IS NO REPLACEMENT for rolling up your sleeves, putting on your waders, and engaging in the battle that is happening on the ground. That’s where we are. That’s where we’ll stay. Tip of the spear.
We will never quit.
Ephesians 6:11. To God be the glory.
Ever onward -

clean_body: Commit today to work in your local elections in 2024. | | | July 21, 2024 | | | HELP WANTED: 107 days of True the Vote, leave nothing on the field Commit today to work in your local elections in 2024. | | | | | | | | | mailto:?subject=Post%20from%20True%20the%20Vote&body=HELP%20WANTED%3A%20107%20days%20of%20True%20the%20Vote%2C%20leave%20nothing%20on%20the%20field%3A%20Commit%20today%20to%20work%20in%20your%20local%20elections%20in%202024.%20%0A%0Ahttps%3A%2F%2Fnewsletter.truethevote.org%2Fp%2Fhelp-wanted-107-days-true-vote-leave-nothing-field ---|---|---|---|---|---|--- | Hi friend - We are 107 days away from November 5th, and worlds away from where we were eight short days ago. From last Saturday’s failed assassination attempt and iconic rebound of President Trump, to, just a few hours ago, in an unprecedented move, President Biden’s announcement that he’s stepped down as the Democrat’s nominee for President. What’s next? Well ... buckle up. I won’t lay it all out here, but based on what we’re hearing we have every reason to believe the twists and turns have only just begun. From now until November (and likely for some period of time thereafter) election integrity will be critical. Here’s what’s happening now, and some of what’s to come, at True the Vote: SCAN. CHECK. PROTECT. \- Over 20,000 people have used to register to vote, check their registration, and remove old records. This is a great way to encourage engagement with family and friends! CLEANING VOTER ROLLS \- We are a few weeks away from the August 8th deadline to challenge ineligible voter registration records. Our platform,, has been used to great effect by over 35,000 volunteers. To date, 6,937 citizens have completed 645,610 challenges across 1,322 counties. LAUNCHING NEW ELECTION SUPPORT APP - Our new app, VoteAlert, is being tested right now and readied for launch in the next few weeks. This app will support realtime online reporting of election incidents and a bilingual toll free call line. TRAINING, TRAINING, TRAINING \- Teambuilding, Logic and Accuracy Participation, Long Term Care and College Outreach, Election Workers, Ballot Signature Verification ... ... we’re hosting Q&A; webinars 3x a week and focused trainings throughout the month. BUILDING QUICK REFERENCE GUIDES FOR ELECTION WORKERS \- Over our nearly 15 years, we’ve learned that when you are working in the field, you need ready access to key intel, contacts, and specific election codes. Every state is different. We’re working with volunteers around the clock to complete these materials and begin distribution. PLANNING FOR EYES ON BALLOT DROPBOXES \- From working with sheriffs to install and monitor dropboxes, to working with citizens to lawfully get eyes on, plans are underway to do all we can minimize the kind of exploitation we saw at ballot dropboxes in 2020. RECRUITMENT OF BILINGUAL POLL WORKERS - True the Vote has been steadily reaching out to the Latino community to encourage participation. Check out it’s True the Vote, but in Spanish. And of course, we are still collaborating with other pro-liberty groups and fighting on many fronts in court, as lawsuits will continue and likely more in store. KNOW THIS LINK IS BEING BLOCKED BY SEVERAL BROWSERS. IF NECESSARY, YOU CAN TYPE IT IN AT Many of the plans we have require significant investments in equipment, data, and tech support. What’s our budget? We will immediately deploy every donation. If we can raise $5,000,000, we will scale up and deploy. If we can only raise $500,000 we will scale down and deploy. It’s nearly impossible to know how to forecast. There are so many competing interests, and everything is happening at breakneck speed. But we are ready. We will spin straw to gold. We will stretch every dollar, and be assured, we are working nonstop. We are all in. We will leave nothing on the field. Hundreds of millions will be raised by candidates and PACs for online messaging and flurries of lawsuits. But THERE IS NO REPLACEMENT for rolling up your sleeves, putting on your waders, and engaging in the battle that is happening on the ground. That’s where we are. That’s where we’ll stay. Tip of the spear. We will never quit. Ephesians 6:11. To God be the glory. Ever onward - | P.S. Please join me tomorrow for Lunch and Learn at noon central, or for the . After weeks of speculation, President Biden has announced that he will not seek re-election. He has endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to take up the mantle of the presidency. In his letter to the country, President Biden wrote, "_I believe it is in the best interest of my party and my country for me to stand down_." As the nation absorbs this significant transition, here are three critical steps that Vice President Harris must take to secure the White House, win back the House, maintain control of the Senate--and ultimately work towards saving our democracy.
**Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a3cd28fa-c386-42cd-bb8a-d47de6e2d257?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

## 1\. Expose the Dangers of Project 2025
Vice President Harris must launch a full-court press against the fascist Project 2025. This initiative poses a severe threat to our democracy, decimating voting rights, reproductive rights, immigration, education--every major pillar of separation of religion and state. As [I've written before](https://substack.com/redirect/89dac6aa-9ffe-48ac-874f-9d839cc67055?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), electing Trump will further accelerate Project 2025's goal of implementing Christian nationalism in American government.
VP Harris must articulate clearly and forcefully how Project 2025 undermines democratic principles and threatens the very foundation of our nation. By highlighting the dangers and rallying the public against it, she can galvanize support and build a broad coalition dedicated to preserving our democracy.
## 2\. Present an Inspiring Vision of Economic, Social, and Climate Justice
While exposing the dangers of Project 2025 is necessary, it is not sufficient to win this election. We need bold leadership on what we are running for and voting for--namely economic, social, and climate justice for all people in this country. Currently, 78% of Americans are living paycheck to paycheck, struggling to make ends meet. Meanwhile, anti-Black, anti-Muslim, antisemitic, anti-LGBTQ, anti-Immigrant and misogynistic hate crimes are at record highs.
Additionally, the last 12 months have been the hottest on record, underscoring the urgency of the climate crisis. Vice President Harris's opening remarks and subsequent campaign must focus on a robust economic agenda that addresses income inequality and provides tangible relief to struggling families. She must also commit to combating white supremacy and terrorism, ensuring that all Americans can live free from fear and discrimination.
Finally, her climate justice policy must be comprehensive and ambitious, tackling the root causes of climate change and promoting sustainable solutions that protect our planet while strengthening our economy and job growth. Doing so will continue to active new and younger voters who are starved for attention from a President who acts with urgency on climate. VP Harris has previously endorsed the Green New Deal and Medicare for All -- now is the time to act upon it.
## 3\. Stand Firm Against War Crimes in Palestine
With Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu visiting this week, Vice President Harris has a crucial opportunity to address the ongoing genocide against the Palestinian people. She must unequivocally condemn the war crimes being committed and demand accountability from Israel. By taking a strong stand, Harris can signal that the United States will no longer fund these atrocities and that human rights will be a cornerstone of her foreign policy.
This position not only aligns with the values of many Americans but also distinguishes her from previous administrations (i.e. the current White House administration) that have often turned a blind eye to these issues.

## Conclusion
If Vice President Harris can effectively combat Project 2025, present a compelling vision of economic, social, and climate justice, and recognize and act to end the horrific war crimes being committed against the Palestinian people, she will not only secure the presidency but also strengthen the Democratic hold on the Senate and reclaim the House. The path forward requires boldness, clarity, and an unwavering commitment to justice and equality for all. I am hopeful that VP Harris will rise to the challenge, because our literal democracy and global peace is at stake.

Today, President Biden withdrew from the 2024 presidential race. I have thoughts I want to share with you on where the Democratic Party goes from here, but first and foremost, I want to congratulate Biden on a historic career.

President Biden made America stronger. He charted a bright path forward for our nation after four tumultuous years under the former administration and made historic contributions to our nation. I couldn’t be more proud of my work on his agenda.

President Biden’s love of country and loyalty to the American people has been unwavering. He will undoubtedly go down in the history books as a true American patriot.

Frankly, another Trump term would be perilous. Just look at his first term: Under executive order, he separated thousands of families at the border. He cut taxes for corporations and the wealthiest Americans. His recklessness addressing the COVID pandemic cost millions of Americans their lives. He instigated the longest government shutdown ever. He used the presidency to incite a violent insurrection against our democracy, completely shattering his facade that he respects the Constitution, our democracy, and rule of law. And of course, he became the first president in the history of the United States to be impeached twice.

The task of defeating Trump at the ballot box is as clear as ever, Derek. We must prevent his lies and his lawlessness from returning to the White House.

I believe Vice President Harris has the experience, energy, and resolve to lead our nation and defeat Donald Trump and his backwards agenda.

**[_I hope you’ll consider splitting a contribution of anything you can between me and Vice President Harris so Democrats can move forward together and beat Donald Trump in November. Mark Warner

Senator Ron Johnson

\*\*ABOUT NELLA\*\*

<-

\*\* New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. \*\*

You might know my husband Hung from his U.S. Senate campaign, and you might even have seen me out and about in our Commonwealth by his side!

But today, I want to take a moment to introduce myself personally, after all you’ve done for our family and our mission.

My name is April Cao, and besides being Hung’s wife I’m an EMT, writer, and mother of five.

You see, my husband owes his life to this country. He and his family escaped communism in Vietnam. If it wasn’t for the generosity of America, he might not be here today.

But he wasn’t satisfied with just settling down in our country and fading into the background. For 25 years, he put his life on the line for America as a U.S. Navy Special Operations Officer.

_And now, even though his military career is over, he’s not done fighting for our country - and that’s why he’s running for U.S. Senate._

**Hung isn’t a career politician like Joe Biden and Tim Kaine. He’s a true American fighter, and he would do ANYTHING to help make our country stronger.**

**[Today, I’m reaching out to ask you to stand with my husband as he embarks on this incredible journey. | I join Americans across the country in recognizing President Joe Biden’s extraordinary career in public service. I am proud to have worked alongside him and my colleagues in Congress to pass the biggest infrastructure package in modern history, lower health care costs for seniors and working families, and defend democracy both at home and abroad. Joe Biden has been one of the most effective presidents of our time, and his patriotism and selflessness are an example for us all.

As we reflect on his extraordinary accomplishments, it is time that we come together on a steady and unified path forward – for all future generations of Americans who will be deeply affected by the outcome of November’s election. That is why I am proud to join the President and many of my colleagues in supporting Kamala Harris to be our next President. She is an accomplished and exceptional public servant, and I look forward to working with her.

I want to take a minute to thank the hundreds of passionate constituents who have reached out over the past few weeks to share their thoughts during this uncertain time. I continue to keep their concerns at the forefront of every decision I make. As always, I’ll remain focused on doing the work I was elected to do, keeping my doors open to any resident of Pennsylvania’s 7th District in need of assistance, and working across the aisle to get things done for the American people.

body:
www.lanonbaccam.com [www.lanonbaccam.com]
Peter,

As I’m sure you’ve seen by now, President Biden has announced he will not seek re-election and will instead focus on fulfilling his duties as President for the remainder of his term.

I want to thank President Biden for his leadership and service to our country. His legacy will be one of selfless dedication to the betterment of our nation and world.

Today, our mission remains unchanged: flip Iowa’s Third Congressional District and take back the House. With just over three months to go, the stakes couldn’t be higher.

In these pivotal times, your support is more important than ever. I’m fired up to flip this seat in November and I hope you are too. There’s more work to do and together we’ll get the job done.

Let's go!

Lanon Baccam

body:
http://www.BolickforArizona.com?mc_cid=7a2c4c7449&mc_eid=UNIQID
Dear Freedom Fighters,

It isn’t often a sitting legislator is sued in his or her official capacity, but last week, every Republican and Democrat serving on Legislative Council to approve the draft ballot analysis for (Make Elections Fair) I-14-
2024 (https://apps.arizona.vote/electioninfo/assets/47/0/BallotMeasures/I-07-2024%20Make%20Elections%20Fair%20Arizona.pdf?mc_cid=7a2c4c7449&mc_eid=UNIQID) and (Arizona for Abortion Access) I-05-2024 (https://apps.arizona.vote/electioninfo/assets/47/0/BallotMeasures/I-05-2024%20Arizona%20for%20Abortion%20Access.pdf?mc_cid=7a2c4c7449&mc_eid=UNIQID) were sued. As you may recall, on July 8^th I filled in for Senator T.J. Shope for that specific meeting (https://www.azleg.gov/ballot-measures-2024-draft-analyses/?mc_cid=7a2c4c7449&mc_eid=UNIQID) . These two separate parties aren’t happy with Legislative Council’s neutral ballot language. Stay tuned as litigation is just beginning.

I signed on to an amici curiae along with other freedom loving groups and elected officials late last week in the case Consumer Research v. Consumer Product Safety Commission. It might take a little bit of time, but slowly, we will undo the damage done by the Left.

This past Thursday marked the one-year anniversary of being picked by the Maricopa County Board of Supervisors from a list of three potential candidates to fulfill (https://arizonadailyindependent.com/2023/07/19/shawnna-bolick-appointed-to-fill-vacant-state-senate-seat/?mc_cid=7a2c4c7449&mc_eid=UNIQID) the remainder of State Senator Steve Kaiser’s legislative term. Today, is the one-year anniversary of taking the oath to serve this great state, again. If you missed it last year, you can see me take my official oath of office right HERE (https://arizonadailyindependent.com/2023/07/23/bolick-becomes-ld2-senator-in-heart-warming-swearing-in-ceremony/?mc_cid=7a2c4c7449&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

On Saturday, AZ Free News published a pro Shawnna Bolick article about who I am and what it means to return to the Capitol. It is great to get some ink that isn't biased against me every now and then. You can read the article HERE (https://azfreenews.com/2024/07/bolick-plans-to-bring-her-passion-for-school-choice-back-to-the-arizona-senate/?mc_cid=7a2c4c7449&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

Endorsements Abound

It wouldn’t be campaign season if candidates weren’t receiving or seeking endorsements. Our campaign has been in full swing since the legislature Sine Die near the end of June.

My campaign has also been racking up many outstanding
endorsements (https://bolickforarizona.com/endorsements?mc_cid=7a2c4c7449&mc_eid=UNIQID) throughout this primary, including endorsements from local associations like

This past week has certainly been one for the history books. First, an assassin shot President Trump at an outdoor Pennsylvania political rally. Thankfully, only Trump's ear was grazed by the bullet and the whole world now knows Secret Service failed the former president by allowing him to take the podium at this rally. Before the RNC Convention kicked off, Trump picked U.S. Senator J.D. Vance (R-OH) as his Vice-Presidential candidate. Then, earlier today, Biden ceded running for president to Kamala Harris, but somehow, he still feels he is fit to remain the current Commander-in-Chief.

What’s next?

I am not a prognosticator, so I will let the pundits figure that out. I will remind you that I remain focused on holding the Arizona state legislature. I am the current State Senator for District 2 AND the top target for a Democratic takeover.

While I am still competing in my contested primary, my liberal opponent in the general election has amassed a massive war chest from mostly out-of-state special interests and Hollywood types in hopes of flipping the State Senate from the current Republican control. As you may recall, each chamber has a one-seat Republican majority.

If I lose either my primary or the general election, Hobbs will no longer have me as a check on her liberal policy agenda.

Keep in mind, my primary opponent not only isn’t electable, but he carries a lot of baggage that will easily hand this seat over to the Democrats.

I am the only current State Senate legislator standing in the way of the liberal takeover of our legislature.

Can you help me fight back by making an investment in my campaign today to help protect our Republican majority from a leftwing Democratic takeover?

I’m proud to be the proven Republican candidate that is helping secure the border, keep taxes low, and support school choice.

My general election opponent has promised to raise taxes, provide government giveaways to illegal immigrants, and opposed securing our border.

Funny, my primary opponent also supports Biden’s open border policies pushed by the Democrats. Talk about "uniparty." You can watch the video
HERE (https://www.instagram.com/p/CHF88gGgwqw/?igsh=MWYxcmczbzZ3MHp4OA%3D%3D&fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAAR0sq_boFPCXP8lC0HdmH2KM7YKfFRDitLhdzZQvoxZ20vzr-HQ0itgVJT0_aem_LTnX1-rnBi7sP3dcEiFvGA&mc_cid=7a2c4c7449&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

I hope I can continue to count on your support (https://secure.anedot.com/vote-bolick-statesenateld2/donate?mc_cid=7a2c4c7449&mc_eid=UNIQID) to keep our GOP majority at the Capitol. Thank you for your continued support as we work towards a victory in this contested primary election so we can move onto the contested general election to defend our Republican majority in the State Senate.

Take care,
Shawnna

Voting Information for the Primary

Early voting is in full swing for Arizona’s July 30^th primary election. If you are a registered voter on the active early voting list, your early ballots were mailed to you already. If you didn't receive it, you should contact your county recorder's office.

If you vote in person during early voting or on election day,
HERE (https://elections.maricopa.gov/voting/where-to-vote.html?mc_cid=7a2c4c7449&mc_eid=UNIQID) is a list of polling locations in Maricopa County.

If you live outside of Maricopa, check
HERE (https://azsos.gov/elections/about-elections/county-election-officials-contact-information?mc_cid=7a2c4c7449&mc_eid=UNIQID) for a list.

If you do vote by mail, please be sure to mail your mail-in ballot back so your ballot is cured and tabulated in a timely manner.

We are past the July 19th deadline to replace an early ballot if you spoiled it. You will need to vote in person between now and Election Day.

The local elections department suggests July 23^rd is the last day to mail back your ballot. Remember: election day is on Tuesday, July 30^th.

Primary Election Guides

If you are still deciding who is the best candidate to represent you for a particular office, you can use the CCEC voter guide (https://storageccec.blob.core.usgovcloudapi.net/public/docs/1027-Web_English_AllDistricts_FINAL.pdf?mc_cid=7a2c4c7449&mc_eid=UNIQID) to read what the candidate says in their own words. These guides were mailed to you at your registered address a few weeks ago.
If you are a values voter, you can refer to the AZ Voter Guide (https://www.azvoterguide.com/?mc_cid=7a2c4c7449&mc_eid=UNIQID) . If you are a Second Amendment supporter, you can check reference a candidate's voting record (https://azcdl.org/voting-records/?mc_cid=7a2c4c7449&mc_eid=UNIQID) with Arizona Citizens Defense League, or to see if the National Rifle Association has endorsed him or her HERE (https://www.nrapvf.org/grades/arizona?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAAR2mQuAO3G79u7_Kbc3EVJZWEdMttbu9p8OIhm_OJhsQm3y5h213kZvEXSo_aem_Vkw3MLpEyQMOatNreGW4oQ&mc_cid=7a2c4c7449&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

**THANK YOU, JOE!!!** Peter, Unite the Country thanks President Biden for four years of leadership and service to the American people. During his tenure, President Biden oversaw the strongest economy in generations, ushered in record low unemployment, enshrined marriage equality into federal law, and passed the largest climate and infrastructure investments in American history. Now, President Biden has chosen to step aside and serve as a bridge to a new generation of leadership. **In the wake of this decision, Unite the Country will follow President Biden’s lead and work to elect Kamala Harris as the next President of the United States.** Our mission moving forward is the same: We _must_ defeat Donald Trump and the MAGA GOP this November. The state of this race may have changed, but the _stakes_ have not. | | | Peter, today, President Biden announced his decision to end his bid for re-election and officially endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris as his pick for the Democratic nominee. As directly impacted Black, brown, queer, and immigrant youth, **our loyalty has never been to a politician.** It has been and always will be to protect our people and to show up for each other. This development does _not_ change what we are against in this election: the rise of fascism, Project 2025, and an attack on all our freedoms. That’s why we’re demanding the Democratic Party put forward a consolidated ticket that represents the interests and issues we most care about, **and there is no time to waste.** Trump has stoked the flames of a violent, white nationalist agenda that his MAGA base is preparing to carry out with or without him in office. We’ve never been more grounded in our mission to block fascism at the local and federal levels, and we need you to join us. Reaching voters and electing champions for immigrant communities and people of color is how we’ll cement pro-immigrant, humane policies, urgent action on climate change, protection for our reproductive freedoms, and more. subject: I am grateful for Joe Biden’s leadership.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mazie Hirono For Hawaii**
body:
And I am ready to elect Kamala Harris as our next president.

|
#
---
Peter, Like millions of Americans, I’m extremely grateful for Joe Biden’s service to our country over the past five decades, and his leadership over the last four years. After four years of utter chaos, President Biden led our country back from the pandemic and into the strongest economic recovery in a century. Under his leadership, Democrats passed landmark legislation to rebuild our nation’s infrastructure, support our veterans, combat the climate crisis, and invest billions in communities throughout Hawaii and across our country. His foreign policy leadership has been exemplary, helping to restore our country’s image on the world stage, strengthen NATO, and marshal international support for Ukraine. **As the only person to have defeated Donald Trump, President Biden understands as well as anybody how high the stakes are this November, and I respect his decision to pass the baton.** Working alongside the President, Vice President Harris has played a critical role in the progress we’ve made, and has shown herself ready to lead our party moving forward. In the Senate, I saw firsthand what a fierce, committed, and effective champion Kamala is for the American people. I’m proud to call Vice President Harris a friend and colleague, and I look forward to doing everything in my power to get her elected to the White House, so we can continue building on the progress of the last four years. **[Our attention now turns again to November 5th. This is Amy Brown and my husband Sam Brown is the Republican nominee for U.S. Senate in Nevada. I first met my husband in the burn unit when he returned from Afghanistan after a roadside bomb exploded under his vehicle. There was one thing about Sam that caught my attention immediately. It wasn’t the burns on his body, it wasn’t the scars on the face. His vibrant faith in God glowed brightly even in his darkest days. Everyone that encountered Sam could see it. For me, Sam was a light that guided me, challenged me, and reconnected me with God and the Church. I had grown up in the Church but had lost my Faith – I was at my rock bottom until I met Sam. During that time, I shared with him some of the struggles I had faced. Peter,

President Biden's decision to exit the presidential race has undoubtedly
introduced uncertainty at the top of the ticket. However, I have
consistently and publicly voiced my strong support for Vice President
Harris. The final decision on the Democratic nominee will likely come at
the DNC, a week after our August 6th Michigan primary. To ensure a
Democratic victory in November, we must forge a robust coalition capable
of driving voter turnout in Michigan.

Our campaign stands out in the Senate primary race as the only one with a
broad, statewide coalition that can secure victory. We are strongly
uniting African Americans, Arab & Muslim communities, Progressives,
Unions, immigrants, and young people. These groups are rallying for our
campaign in the primary, generating the momentum essential for winning
this election cycle. President Biden has selflessly given us a chance to
re-energize the public and secure a win.

Unlike our opponent, who has chosen to focus solely on their own race and
let the presidential process happen in a silo, I believe in being upfront
and uniting people behind the Democratic Party and Kamala Harris. This is
democracy, and nothing works in a vacuum. We have to all work together to
defeat Donald Trump in November. The Democratic Party needs to be united,
and our campaign has a proven track record of uniting people.

Our race is historic. If elected, I would become the 13th Black senator in
U.S. history. Moreover, we have the opportunity to support Kamala Harris
in becoming the first Black woman president. This moment is monumental,
and together, we can make history.

It's imperative to vote for Hill Harper in Michigan and support a winning
unity coalition that our campaign represents!

With the election just 16 days away on August 6th, every dollar gets put
right to work talking to voters. [ https://act.hillharper.com/go/2043?t=1002&akid=1299%2E62735%2E4GMXHZ ]We need your support to keep this
momentum going. Your contribution will help us reach more voters, organize
more events, and ensure every voice is heard.

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE July 21, 2024**
Contact: Kait Ahern — communications@yda.org **

---
**YOUNG DEMOCRATS OF AMERICA ENDORSE KAMALA HARRIS FOR PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES**
---
WASHINGTON, D.C. – Today the Young Democrats of America are proud to endorse Vice President Kamala Harris to be the next President of the United States of America following a unanimous vote by the Executive Board. Since 2020, the Biden-Harris Administration has made incredible strides in advancing the interests of America’s young people. This administration has addressed key issues including student debt forgiveness, climate change, reproductive healthcare, affordable housing, and LGBTQ+ rights. We are eager to see this work continue onward, and we are proud to endorse Vice President Kamala Harris to be the one to do so.
Vice President Kamala Harris has dedicated her accomplished career to championing the rights of young people and fighting for justice. As Attorney General of California, she established Open Justice, an online platform that improved police accountability by making criminal justice data publicly available. As a U.S. Senator, she continued to defend democracy and promote a fair society by advocating for progressive legislation. The American people now have the opportunity to reject fascism, protect our democratic values, and embrace a positive vision for our nation's future—one that Young Democrats across the country enthusiastically support.

As Vice President, Kamala Harris has worked to unite the American people. Convicted felon Donald Trump and JD Vance seek to divide us. Vice President Harris has fought for women's freedom to make decisions about their own bodies. Convicted felons Donald Trump and JD Vance support a national abortion ban and the end of reproductive freedom. Vice President Harris has fought to secure clean drinking water for millions of families and address the climate crisis. Convicted Felon Donald Trump and JD Vance think climate change is a “hoax.” The decision facing the American people - and especially the young people - could not be more stark.

As President, Kamala Harris would be the first Black woman and the first person of Indian descent to become leader of the free world. The historic nature of a Harris Presidency presents an opportunity for America to demonstrate to the world, and to ourselves, that we are truly a nation where diversity empowers the very best of us.

The Trump-Vance agenda is a threat to American democracy and the rights we hold dear. If elected, they will stop at nothing to roll back decades of progress in reproductive, environmental, LGBTQ+, racial, and criminal justice. Trump’s Project 2025 is an existential threat to the future of our nation and the sanctity of the free world. Now is the time to unify our party for the good of our nation, behind a force for good— a woman who will serve us with dignity, honor, and fight passionately to expand democracy. **The Young Democrats of America are proud and honored to endorse Kamala Harris to be the next President of the United States of America.**
---

name: Wes Moore
subject: President Biden's legacy
body:
Friend,

President Biden has dedicated his life and career to serving the American people. His legacy of hard work, dedication, optimism, and strength have shaped the trajectory of our nation – and made us better as a people and as a country.

This is a man deeply in love with his family, his country, and the promise of America. As a governor, I look to him as an exemplar of true leadership. As an American, I look to him as an embodiment of our shared values of freedom, decency, and patriotism.

Maryland has had a stalwart ally and tireless friend in President Biden. We could not have delivered such enormous progress for 6.3 million Marylanders without his and Vice President Harris’ leadership and support. Together, we’ve created nearly 40,000 jobs, made historic investments in our state’s infrastructure, and seen the most significant drop in crime in a generation. And when the Francis Scott Key Bridge collapsed on the early morning of March 26, President Biden rallied with the people of our state. Together, we proved what it means to be Maryland Tough and Baltimore Strong.

Our state and our country are back on track with the help of this administration, and we know that President Biden will continue to have Maryland’s back as he focuses solely on fulfilling his duties as president for the rest of his term. I thank him and Dr. Jill Biden for their unwavering loyalty to us, it will never be forgotten.

Elevate,

Wes

body:
#

Friends —
Joe Biden has been one of the most consequential presidents of all time.
The President’s decision not to seek re-election took incredible humility, but that is the Joe Biden I know — someone who puts what he believes is best for his country above all else.
I’m proud that I was able to serve in the Senate while he led us out of the pandemic and took historic steps to rebuild our infrastructure. In Arizona, we’ve made investments to bring back microchips and clean energy manufacturing. On the world stage, he has made our country safer and reinvigorated our alliances.
The President just endorsed Kamala Harris and so do I. I could not be more confident that Vice President Kamala Harris is the right person to defeat Donald Trump and lead our country into the future. She has my support, and I’ll do everything I can to elect her President of the United States.
And in this critical moment, I am humbly asking:
[**Can you split a donation of $3 between my campaign and Kamala Harris for President? We have to move fast to build a campaign that can win in Arizona and nationwide. body:
| **President Joe Biden has officially dropped out of the race for President and endorsed Kamala Harris.**

So we’re sending a HUGE Thank you letter to President Biden for all of his service to our country.

[**We need 20,000 good Democrats to sign it with us — read below and sign the letter >>**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/72785?t=6&akid=15706%2E878179%2EtaWEBP) [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/72785?t=7&akid=15706%2E878179%2EtaWEBP) | [20,000 GOOD DEMOCRATS NEEDED: PLEASE GIVE $3 TO INSTANTLY SIGN THIS LETTER BEFORE WE CLOSE IT AT END-OF-DAY TODAY »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/72785?t=8&akid=15706%2E878179%2EtaWEBP)
---
Dear President Biden,

I have one thing to say to you: Thank you.

You have accomplished so much, and saved our country from the nightmare that Donald Trump left behind.

I remember how excited I was when you won in 2020.

I have had your back since you became President, and I am so proud of everything you've done for working families in our country.

You capped prices on prescription drugs.

You protected good-paying union jobs.

You passed historic legislation addressing climate change.

You have done everything in your power to strengthen our Democracy.

I have zero doubt in my mind: _You will go down as a truly GREAT American President._

**I respect your decision to step aside from the race, and I truly thank you for putting the country and our Democracy first — that is something that Trump and the Republicans will NEVER do.**

[**I'm signing this letter and sending a small donation of $3 with VPP now to show that I'm still fighting — for our country and for your legacy, Mr. President.
